title: Forward Deployed Engineering Manager
description: <p>As the Forward Deployed Engineering Manager, you will lead the team that puts Auterion's robotic systems to work with customers in the field. We build complete systems: vehicles, sensors, onboard compute, radio links, autonomy software, and ground control. Your job is to understand how all of it fits together and to make it work in real missions.</p> <p>You will lead your team through the entire customer engagement, from discovery and integration to field trials and handover. You are not a hardware specialist. You are a systems engineer who can trace a problem across every layer of the system, lead people well, and earn the trust of demanding customers.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities and Duties</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Team Leadership &amp; Mentorship:</strong> Lead and grow a cross-functional team of Forward Deployed Engineers covering systems integration and software. Hire, coach, and develop your engineers. Build a culture of ownership and proactive problem-solving.</li> <li><strong>Accountability:</strong> Keep the bar high for yourself and your team. Work directly with stakeholders across the company. You will have a close relationship with the CTO, CEO, VP of Engineering, and the engineering directors.</li> <li><strong>Field Deployment Oversight:</strong> Own technical delivery of customer deployments in demanding, non-standard environments. This covers system configuration, connectivity, mission readiness, and operation under environmental constraints.</li> <li><strong>System Integration:</strong> Act as the technical lead for high-stakes customer integrations. Ensure the full system works end to end: vehicle, payloads, onboard compute, communication links, autonomy software, and ground control.</li> <li><strong>Field Troubleshooting:</strong> Diagnose failures across hardware, firmware, software, and communications. Use logs, telemetry, and structured debugging to find root causes fast.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management:</strong> Serve as the primary technical contact for defense and enterprise customers. Translate operational requirements into deployment plans that account for system performance, link quality, power, and mission constraints. Run technical meetings, demos, and field days.</li> <li><strong>Feedback Loop &amp; Release Coordination:</strong> Work closely with Product and R&amp;D to feed field results and real-world edge cases back into the product. Coordinate with R&amp;D on platform releases so customer deployments stay current and stable.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications and Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Systems Engineering:</strong> 7+ years in technical roles in robotics, drones, autonomous vehicles, or comparable complex embedded systems. You understand the full system end to end and how a change in one subsystem affects the others.</li> <li><strong>Leadership Experience:</strong> 3+ years managing a technical, customer-facing team (Field Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Solutions Architects, or similar). You have dealt with underperformance and built team culture deliberately.</li> <li><strong>Software Skills:</strong> Comfortable working in Linux. You write Python, read C++, and use Git. You debug from logs and telemetry, not only at the bench.</li> <li><strong>Hardware Fluency:</strong> You understand hardware at integration level: power, sensors, interfaces, and RF basics. You do not need to be a hardware designer.</li> <li><strong>Field Deployment Expertise:</strong> Hands-on experience with field-deployed systems where "turning it off and on again" isn't always an option. Understanding of networking and radio communication is a major plus.</li> <li><strong>Crisis Management:</strong> Proven ability to troubleshoot critical failures in the field under high pressure and with limited physical access to the hardware.</li> <li><strong>Customer Presence:</strong> Composure and credibility in front of demanding customers. You communicate clearly with engineers and decision-makers alike.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Fluent English. German is a strong plus.</li> <li><strong>Work Authorization:</strong> Must hold EU citizenship and be eligible to work in the European Union without restriction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, or ROS2</li> <li>Background in defense or government programs</li> <li>Eligibility for German security clearance</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Flexible working hours</li> <li>Stock Options</li> <li>Generous holiday allowance</li> <li>Pension plan&nbsp;</li> <li>Extended social security package&nbsp;</li> <li>Enhanced maternity &amp; paternity leave</li> <li>Wellpass membership&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Auterion</strong></h3> <p>We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.</p> <p>At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.</p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <p>As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems.&nbsp;</p> <p>In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation.&nbsp;</p> <p>This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.</li> <li>Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload <p><strong>Qualifications and Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field</li> <li>Working proficiency in C/C++ and description: ABOUT ROCKET LAB Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us. SPACE SYSTEMS At Rocket Lab, we're not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.  Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions. DIRECTOR - BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT, SPACE SYSTEMS   Based in Munich, Germany , as the Director - Business Development , you will drive Rocket Lab's growth in the European satellite market, with a primary focus on Germany and strategic opportunities across Europe. You will work with a range of customers, including government, defense, civil space, commercial, and prime contractor organizations, with a particular focus on national security and sovereign European space capabilities. Your role will involve identifying and engaging with potential clients, developing strategic partnerships, and leading efforts to secure contracts that expand our market share in this rapidly growing sector. WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO: Lead business development initiatives focused on satellite solutions for defense, national security, civil space, and commercial applications across Germany and Europe Develop and execute capture strategies for securing large defense, civil space, and government contracts, including opportunities with German and European government agencies, defense organizations, space institutions, and prime contractors Engage with key customer stakeholders, government officials, policymakers, and industry leaders to build and maintain long-term relationships, ensuring Rocket Lab's solutions align with their evolving mission requirements and strategic priorities Develop and maintain relationships across the German and European space and defense ecosystem, including government organizations, prime contractors, industry partners, and relevant European institutions Collaborate closely with Government Affairs and cross-functional teams to support market expansion, customer engagement, and pursuit of government-funded programs Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prepare and deliver compelling proposals that meet customer requirements and win new business Monitor German and European industry trends, government priorities, procurement initiatives, policy developments, and competitor activities to inform and adapt our business development strategies Grow existing business opportunities and nurture relationships with existing customers to develop additional business opportunities Create new business opportunities and relationships by presenting Rocket Lab's capabilities/experience to provide satellite solutions – including bus offerings and complete satellites to meet mission requirements Identify and pursue opportunities associated with European sovereign space and defense capabilities, dual-use technologies, and evolving European procurement priorities Lead and/or participate in proposal activities, including generation of technical, management, cost, schedule, and proposal content for new business Develop strong relationships across all levels of the business to ensure alignment, efficiency, and collaboration, including coordinating with stakeholders across Business Development, Government Affairs, Engineering, Program Management, and Operations Represent Rocket Lab at industry conferences, government forums, industry associations, and customer meetings across Germany and Europe Build awareness of relevant European government programs and procurement pathways, including opportunities involving ESA, the European Union, EUSPA, the European Defense Agency, DLR, and German defense and space organizations  Support Rocket Lab's positioning within the evolving European space and defense landscape, affecting Rocket Lab's ability to pursue European opportunities, including ITAR/EAR and applicable German and European requirements Travel as needed for business opportunities, customer meetings, industry events, and capture activities Other duties as assigned or required YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor's degree in engineering or other technical discipline 12+ years of experience in business development, program management, or systems engineering within the aerospace, space, defense, or related technology sector In-depth knowledge of government acquisition processes, government contracting, and the national security landscape within Germany and/or Europe Proven track record of securing large (>$20M) contracts and managing strategic relationships within the aerospace, space, or defense industry Demonstrated experience building and managing relationships with senior government officials, defense organizations, policymakers, prime contractors, and other public- and private-sector stakeholders Professional fluency in German and English Strong understanding of German and European defense priorities, civil space programs, government procurement processes, and the broader European space and defense ecosystem Ability to support frequent domestic and international travel (up to 50%) to meet with clients, attend industry events, and support capture efforts Ability to obtain and maintain any required German or European security clearance, if applicable to assigned programs THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE: Master's degree in security, defense, civil space, or government customers Demonstrable record of success in business development, sales, program management and/or engineering of satellite systems, payloads, or platforms Extensive awareness of current and ongoing German and European government national security, defense, civil space, and satellite programs Experience working with or within organizations such European government-funded programs and navigating German or EU defense and space procurement pathways Familiarity with European sovereign space and defense initiatives, including the European Defense requirements Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills in both German and English Experience leading, managing, and growing geographically dispersed teams on fast-paced projects Proficient in all Microsoft Suite products, including MS Project General knowledge of industry specific technical requirements and quality requirements Experience using customer relationship Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more. 

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.  

DIRECTOR - BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT, SPACE SYSTEMS  

Based in Munich, Germany, as the Director - Business Development, you will drive Rocket Lab's growth in the European satellite market, with a primary focus on Germany and strategic opportunities across Europe. You will work with a range of customers, including government, defense, civil space, commercial, and prime contractor organizations, with a particular focus on national security and sovereign European space capabilities. Your role will involve identifying and engaging with potential clients, developing strategic partnerships, and leading efforts to secure contracts that expand our market share in this rapidly growing sector.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

  • Lead business development initiatives focused on satellite solutions for defense, national security, civil space, and commercial applications across Germany and Europe
  • Develop and execute capture strategies for securing large defense, civil space, and government contracts, including opportunities with German and European government agencies, defense organizations, space institutions, and prime contractors
  • Engage with key customer stakeholders, government officials, policymakers, and industry leaders to build and maintain long-term relationships, ensuring Rocket Lab's solutions align with their evolving mission requirements and strategic priorities
  • Develop and maintain relationships across the German and European space and defense ecosystem, including government organizations, prime contractors, industry partners, and relevant European institutions
  • Collaborate closely with Government Affairs and cross-functional teams to support market expansion, customer engagement, and pursuit of government-funded programs
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prepare and deliver compelling proposals that meet customer requirements and win new business
  • Monitor German and European industry trends, government priorities, procurement initiatives, policy developments, and competitor activities to inform and adapt our business development strategies
  • Grow existing business opportunities and nurture relationships with existing customers to develop additional business opportunities
  • Create new business opportunities and relationships by presenting Rocket Lab's capabilities/experience to provide satellite solutions – including bus offerings and complete satellites to meet mission requirements
  • Identify and pursue opportunities associated with European sovereign space and defense capabilities, dual-use technologies, and evolving European procurement priorities
  • Lead and/or participate in proposal activities, including generation of technical, management, cost, schedule, and proposal content for new business
  • Develop strong relationships across all levels of the business to ensure alignment, efficiency, and collaboration, including coordinating with stakeholders across Business Development, Government Affairs, Engineering, Program Management, and Operations
  • Represent Rocket Lab at industry conferences, government forums, industry associations, and customer meetings across Germany and Europe
  • Build awareness of relevant European government programs and procurement pathways, including opportunities involving ESA, the European Union, EUSPA, the European Defense Agency, DLR, and German defense and space organizations 
  • Support Rocket Lab's positioning within the evolving European space and defense landscape, including launch sovereignty, European sovereign capability, dual-use technology, and defense modernization priorities
  • Develop an understanding of relevant export control and regulatory considerations affecting Rocket Lab's ability to pursue European opportunities, including ITAR/EAR and applicable German and European requirements
  • Travel as needed for business opportunities, customer meetings, industry events, and capture activities
  • Other duties as assigned or required

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or other technical discipline
  • 12+ years of experience in business development, program management, or systems engineering within the aerospace, space, defense, or related technology sector
  • In-depth knowledge of government acquisition processes, government contracting, and the national security landscape within Germany and/or Europe
  • Proven track record of securing large (>$20M) contracts and managing strategic relationships within the aerospace, space, or defense industry
  • Demonstrated experience building and managing relationships with senior government officials, defense organizations, policymakers, prime contractors, and other public- and private-sector stakeholders
  • Professional fluency in German and English
  • Strong understanding of German and European defense priorities, civil space programs, government procurement processes, and the broader European space and defense ecosystem
  • Ability to support frequent domestic and international travel (up to 50%) to meet with clients, attend industry events, and support capture efforts
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any required German or European security clearance, if applicable to assigned programs

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Master's degree in aerospace engineering or related engineering field; or business
  • Specialization in German or European government business development, with deep experience selling to German or European national security, defense, civil space, or government customers
  • Demonstrable record of success in business development, sales, program management and/or engineering of satellite systems, payloads, or platforms
  • Extensive awareness of current and ongoing German and European government national security, defense, civil space, and satellite programs
  • Experience working with or within organizations such as DLR, Bundeswehr, BAAINBw, German federal government entities, ESA, EUSPA, the European Defense Agency, EU defense bodies, NATO, or other European space and defense institutions
  • Experience pursuing European government-funded programs and navigating German or EU defense and space procurement pathways
  • Familiarity with European sovereign space and defense initiatives, including the European Defense Fund (EDF), European Defense Industry Program (EDIP), EU Space Program initiatives, and related European defense modernization priorities
  • Familiarity with NATO space and defense structures and European security and resilience priorities
  • Understanding of export control regimes and regulatory considerations relevant to European business development, including ITAR/EAR and German/EU requirements
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills in both German and English
  • Experience leading, managing, and growing geographically dispersed teams on fast-paced projects
  • Proficient in all Microsoft Suite products, including MS Project
  • General knowledge of industry specific technical requirements and quality requirements
  • Experience using customer relationship management (CRM) software
  • Experience with proposal development, writing, and best practice capture processes, and ability to independently complete cost and technical proposals
  • Experience working with subject matter experts to collect and create compelling proposal content and detailed responses

WHAT TO EXPECT 

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Du denkst analytisch, fühlst dich wohl im Analysieren von Zahlen und kommunizierst datenbasierte Erkenntnisse sicher. Organisationstalent zeichnet dich aus – du arbeitest strukturiert, behältst den Überblick und kannst Aufgaben effizient priorisieren. Du besitzt eine generelle Affinität für digitale Tools wie z. B. CRM-Systeme, Notion, Google Workspace oder n8n. Deine ersten 90 Tage: Die ersten sechs Wochen – Orientierung und Einarbeitung Lerne unsere Prozesse kennen – vom internen Handover der Neukunden von Sales, über die Anmeldung von Lieferstellen bis hin zur Marktkommunikation im komplexen Energiemarkt. Mache dich mit den wichtigsten Tools, Systemen sowie internen und externen Ansprechpartnern vertraut, die beim Onboarding unserer Neukunden eine Rolle spielen. Führe deine ersten Kunden-Onboardings eigenständig durch: Stelle die „Handover-Readiness" durch Sales sicher, richte das Kundenportal ein, initiiere den Kundenkontakt, melde Lieferstellen an und löse Probleme in der Marktkommunikation. Bis zum dritten Monat – Verantwortung übernehmen und Prozesse weiterentwickeln Übernimm Kunden-Onboardings eigenständig und verantworte Timelines sowie die Kommunikation mit allen Beteiligten. Entwickle ein belastbares Verständnis für Marktkommunikationsprozesse und werde zur verlässlichen Ansprechperson bei Problemen in deinem Bereich. Erkenne wiederkehrende Muster in typischen Fehlern und bring eigene Ideen ein, um unsere Onboarding-Prozesse gezielt zu verbessern. Warum wir? Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und treibe eigenverantwortlich Projekte voran, die echten Einfluss haben – auf unsere Produkte, unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und die Umwelt. Das erwartet dich bei uns: Dein Impact: Du übernimmst Verantwortung in unserem dynamischen Team und gestaltest aktiv innovative Produkte, die die Energiewende vorantreiben und zur Dekarbonisierung des Mittelstandes beitragen. Flexibles Arbeiten: In unserem schönen Office fördern wir eine lebendige Unternehmenskultur. Homeoffice ist ebenfalls eine Option. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, 30 Urlaubstagen und 10 Tagen Workation unterstützen wir deine Work-Life-Balance. Attraktive Benefits: Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erhältst du Essensgutscheine, eine Urban Sports-Mitgliedschaft, reichlich kostenlose Snacks und ein persönliches Produktivitätsbudget. Persönliche Entwicklung: Du bist Teil eines tollen Teams, wo Coaching und Mentoring groß geschrieben wird, und arbeitest mit Spitzentechnologien und lernst von Branchenexpert:innen. Vielfalt & Inklusion: Bei uns sind alle willkommen – wir engagieren uns für einen integrativen Arbeitsplatz, der Vielfalt wertschätzt. Wir ermutigen Menschen unterschiedlichen Geschlechts, Alters, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, sozialer Herkunft und körperlicher oder neurodiverser Vielfalt zur Bewerbung. Über uns Willkommen im trawa-Universum! Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, das grüne Versorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft von Grund auf aufzubauen. Wir schaffen einen direkten Zugang zu erneuerbarer Energie für B2B-Industrieunternehmen, entwickeln Software und Technologie, um die Volatilität des Energiemarktes zu bewältigen, und professionalisieren die Energiebeschaffung auf der Käuferseite. raw.title: Machine Learning Engineer (f/m/d)
raw.description:
Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

This role sits at the intersection of ML engineering and computational physics, working within our Software Engineering & Digital Twin environments. You'll collaborate closely with optical engineers, laser and fusion physicists, simulation scientists, and systems engineers to embed data-driven intelligence directly into our Digital Twin architecture. You’ll be reducing design risk, shortening development timelines, and unlocking system-level optimization that purely physics-based approaches can't achieve at the speed we need.

You will design, build, and deploy machine learning models that enhance, accelerate, and augment our multiphysics simulation environments across our high-energy laser systems, target injection and tracking system, target manufacturing system, and fusion chamber. This will enable faster design cycles, predictive system optimization, and real-time decision support across our laser, targetry, and fusion programs.

What You'll Do

  • Surrogate & reduced-order modeling: Design and deploy surrogate and reduced-order models (ROMs) that replace or accelerate high-fidelity multiphysics simulations in the Digital Twin environment

  • Physics-informed ML: Develop physics-informed machine learning (PIML) and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that embed physical constraints (Maxwell's equations, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics) directly into model architectures

  • ML pipelines: Build and maintain ML pipelines for training, validation, uncertainty quantification (UQ), and continuous model refinement against experimental and simulation data

  • Active learning & Bayesian optimization: Implement active learning and Bayesian optimization workflows to intelligently guide design space exploration and reduce costly simulation runs

  • Digital Twin integration: Integrate trained ML models into the broader Digital Twin framework, interfacing with HPC simulation outputs (COMSOL, ANSYS, custom solvers) and real-time sensor data

  • Anomaly detection: Develop anomaly detection and predictive diagnostics models to monitor system health and identify off-nominal behavior in laser subsystems

  • Autonomous optimization: Apply reinforcement learning and Bayesian control approaches to support autonomous or semi-autonomous optimization of laser operating parameters

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Collaborate with Digital Twin architects, systems engineers, and optical simulation scientists to ensure ML models meet fidelity, latency, and uncertainty requirements

  • Engineering rigor: Establish best practices for model versioning, reproducibility, testing, and documentation in a fast-moving research environment

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Master's or PhD in Machine Learning, Computational Physics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a closely related field

  • Proven experience building, training, and deploying ML models for complex physical systems; strong command of deep learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow/JAX), probabilistic models, and uncertainty quantification

  • Expert-level Python; proficiency in C++ or Fortran a plus; experience with HPC environments (batch schedulers, MPI/OpenMP parallelization)

  • Fluency working with PDE-based simulation outputs, time-series sensor data, and high-dimensional parameter spaces typical of multiphysics environments

  • Hands-on experience with Gaussian processes, neural network surrogates, reduced-order models, or equivalent metamodeling techniques

  • Experience building robust ML pipelines for scientific data — including preprocessing, feature engineering, model validation, and deployment

  • Ability to communicate model behavior, confidence intervals, and limitations clearly to physicists, engineers, and non-ML specialists

  • Strong cross-functional team skills; comfort working in an interdisciplinary environment spanning physics, engineering, and software

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) or neural operators (DeepONet, FNO) applied to physical systems

  • Background in laser physics, plasma physics, high-energy-density science, or related complex physics domains

  • Experience with digital twin platforms and live integration of ML models with simulation environments (e.g., NVIDIA Omniverse, Siemens Xcelerator, ANSYS Twin Builder)

  • Familiarity with multidisciplinary design optimization (MDO) workflows, including Design of Experiments (DoE), sensitivity analysis, and uncertainty propagation

  • Experience applying reinforcement learning to physical system control or optimization

  • Familiarity with Monte Carlo methods and statistical uncertainty quantification frameworks

  • Experience with MLOps tooling (MLflow, Weights & Biases, DVC) in a scientific computing context

  • Interest in fusion energy, advanced laser systems, or high-energy-density physics

  • PostgreSQL for persisting our data

raw.description:
About Us

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.


Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.


Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity.

About the Team

The Enterprise team owns 1GLOBAL's products for businesses: global mobile connectivity for multinational enterprises, delivered through one platform, one contract and one invoice. Our customers manage their entire mobile estate in the Enterprise Portal, from subscriptions, usage and invoices to orders such as SIM swaps and suspensions, spend alerts, user roles and single sign-on.

We recently retired two legacy portals and moved every enterprise customer onto our new Enterprise Portal. That has created strong demand and a steady flow of requests from customers and internal teams, with a lot of exciting work ahead. We work closely with engineering, design, customer support, customer success, account management, operations and commercial teams.

We are looking for a Product Manager to shape the next chapter of the Enterprise Portal: what we show, how we show it, which reports and analytics we offer, and which actions customers can take themselves. This is a UI and UX-heavy role, where design judgement matters as much as sharp prioritisation.

About the Role

You will lead discovery and delivery for the Enterprise Portal, turning a high volume of customer and internal requests into a clear roadmap and a portal that enterprise customers enjoy using.

  • Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for the Enterprise Portal, deciding which dashboards, reports, analytics and self-service capabilities come next.
  • Run customer and UX research: talk to portal users directly and gather the voice of the customer from support, customer success, account management and operations.
  • Work hands-on with design from first concept to final UI, shaping flows, wireframes and prototypes and holding a high bar for UX and UI quality.
  • Shape the portal's integrations with mobile device management (MDM) platforms such as Jamf and Microsoft Intune, so enterprise IT teams can manage devices and connectivity together.
  • Prioritise work of every size, from small fixes and quick improvements to large multi-quarter projects, and communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly to every stakeholder.
  • Use analytics and data to understand how customers use the portal, spot friction and measure the impact of what we ship.
  • Write clear requirements and acceptance criteria with engineering, understanding the APIs behind the portal well enough to shape what is feasible.

Requirements

About You

Must Have

  • 4+ years in product management, including ownership of a B2B portal, dashboard or web application used by business customers.
  • Hands-on experience with customer and UX research: interviews and turning feedback from many channels into clear problems worth solving.
  • Experience with event-based product analytics such as Amplitude or similar products: defining events, building charts and funnels, and using the data to make decisions.
  • Strong prioritisation across a constant flow of requests, with the judgement to say no and the ability to explain why.
  • Proven collaboration across many departments, from engineering and design to customer success, account management, operations and sales, in fluent written and spoken English.
  • A working understanding of APIs and how a portal reads and writes data through them. This is not a technical role, but API fluency will help you shape what is feasible with engineers.


Nice to Have

  • Telecom experience, for example enterprise mobile services, MVNO platforms or eSIM.
  • Hands-on Amplitude experience, including tracking plans, event taxonomy and dashboards.
  • Experience with design systems, or with data visualisation for business users.

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Handwerksbetrieben sowie der Prüfung von Angeboten, Leistungsänderungen und Nachträgen . About baesh

baesh is a social platform connecting people in real life through events, communities, and shared interests.

We’re a small team using AI to move quickly from ideas to working experiences. Research is central to how we decide what to build and whether it’s good enough to ship. Your work will help us stay close to people as the technology moves faster.

You’ll work closely with our Head of Product and UX, an experienced researcher with a PhD in emotional and behavioural research. You’ll get practical guidance across the research process—from deciding what to investigate to helping the team act on what we learn.

This is an unpaid mandatory internship for students whose university programme requires a placement.

  • Location: Mostly remote, with opportunities to join research and events in Berlin.

  • Start date: Flexible, depending on your university requirements.

  • Duration: As required by your university, usually 3–6 months.

What you’ll help with

Usability testing and idea validation

  • Help plan and run usability tests on our app and prototypes, including interfaces built with AI.

  • Explore how easily people can discover events, join communities, and create their profiles.

  • Test whether experiences make sense to real people, beyond looking polished or functioning technically.

  • Validate early ideas and assumptions before the team invests further.

  • Identify confusing moments and recommend improvements that make a meaningful difference.

Exploratory research and interviews

  • Help interview existing users and people who haven’t tried baesh yet.

  • Explore how people make friends, find things to do, and connect with communities.

  • Understand their needs, motivations, habits, and barriers.

  • Help write discussion guides and ask open questions that uncover useful insights.

  • Bring people’s experiences into product decisions, keeping the human connection at the heart of how we build.

AI-supported research

  • Use AI to help draft interview guides, usability-testing scripts, and survey questions.

  • Explore how AI can support research synthesis by organising notes, summarising sessions, and suggesting patterns.

  • Check AI-generated summaries and interpretations against what participants actually said and did.

  • Learn where AI saves time, where it misses nuance, and where your judgement matters most.

  • Help us develop practical ways to combine faster research workflows with thoughtful, reliable findings.

Recruitment and ongoing feedback

  • Help recruit participants and coordinate research sessions.

  • Support Friends of BAESH, our community of early adopters who contribute through interviews, user testing, feedback, and feature suggestions.

  • Help create short in-app surveys about specific parts of the experience.

Making sense of what we learn

  • Analyse feedback and identify patterns across sessions.

  • Turn findings into clear insights and practical recommendations.

  • Share research with the product and development team to shape what happens next.

  • Help organise our research so we can build on previous learning.

You won’t be expected to do all of this independently from day one. We’ll guide you, give you feedback, and gradually help you take ownership of research activities.

What you’ll bring

  • You’re enrolled in a degree programme that requires a mandatory internship.

  • An interest in UX research, psychology, human–computer interaction, design, sociology, or a related field.

  • Curiosity about people and a willingness to question assumptions.

  • Good listening skills and an empathetic, respectful approach.

  • Strong communication skills in English.

  • An organised approach and willingness to take initiative.

  • An interest in using AI thoughtfully, including questioning its output.

Preferred, but not required:

  • German-speaking, so you can support research with German-speaking participants.

  • Some familiarity with interviews, usability testing, surveys, or qualitative analysis—university projects count.

  • Experience experimenting with AI tools for research, writing, analysis, or prototyping.

  • An interest in social products, communities, and how digital experiences support real-life connections.

If you have relevant university work or a portfolio, we’d love to see it—but it’s optional.

Qualifikation Abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Immobilienwirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, sowie idealerweise 1–3 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einem Startup, einer Unternehmensberatung oder im Projektmanagement. Ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Denken , analytische Fähigkeiten und ein gutes Verständnis für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge. Hohe Eigeninitiative und Ownership-Mentalität : Du erkennst Herausforderungen selbstständig, entwickelst Lösungsansätze und treibst Themen proaktiv voran. Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, auch in einem dynamischen Umfeld Prioritäten zu setzen. Kommunikationsstärke und ein souveränes Auftreten im Austausch mit Kollegen, Kunden, Partnern und der Geschäftsführung. Sicherer Umgang mit Google Workspace, diversen KIs, sowie KI-gestützten Anwendungen sowie Interesse an Automatisierung und Prozessoptimierung. Begeisterung für Unternehmertum, Immobilien, Digitalisierung und den Aufbau eines wachsenden Unternehmens . Benefits Pionierarbeit: Sei Teil eines motivierten Teams, das die Art und Weise, wie Renovierungen geplant und durchgeführt werden, komplett neu gestaltet Gestaltungsspielraum: Deine Ideen sind gefragt! Hilf uns, Prozesse und Abläufe weiterzuentwickeln und zu optimieren, um die Immobilien bestmöglich zu sanieren Modernes Arbeiten: Büro in der Hamburger Speicherstadt, modernste Soft- & Hardware, sowie flexible Arbeitszeiten, flache Hierarchien und schnelle Entscheidungen (Kaffee, Cola, Tee und Obst haben wir natürlich auch ;)) Vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Die Chance, in einer wachsenden Firma Verantwortung zu übernehmen und sich weiterzuentwickeln Arbeit auf Augenhöhe: Wir legen besonderen Wert auf ein respektvolles Miteinander und begegnen jedem auf Augenhöhe - unabhängig davon, ob es sich um Makler, Maler, Praktikanten oder Geschäftsführer handelt. Dann bewirb Dich jetzt und sende uns deine Bewerbungsunterlagen inkl. potenziellem Startdatum und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen! 🚀 Hinweis: Zur besseren Lesbarkeit wird in dieser Stellenanzeige das generische Maskulinum verwendet, alle verwendeten Personenbezeichnungen beziehen sich auf alle Geschlechter. title: Senior Software Engineer, Inference Performance
description: About Tensordyne  AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! The role You'll build the software stack that takes a model from code down to the hardware: the abstractions, kernels, libraries, and tools that engineers and agents use to reach peak performance. Help optimize the latest AI models on our silicon. Our hardware is designed to be straightforward to program, so the goal is not to hide it. The goal is to expose the right level of control at each layer, from our compiler-driven Python SDK to our low-level Rust programming stack, and to make every performance gap measurable and every fix permanent. We're looking for a builder who understands hardware deeply and develops with agents by default. You'll own substantial parts of one of these layers and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your focus is performance: where cycles, bandwidth, and communication go, and how to win them back. Number formats and model accuracy are owned by our conversion and emulation team; you'll partner with them where precision and speed meet. What you'll do Build the stack. Design APIs, kernel abstractions, and libraries in our Python SDK or Rust stack so model engineers and agents can reach high performance at the layer that fits their problem. Make models fast. Take priority workloads, from LLMs to multimodal models, to peak performance on real silicon. Profile, find the bottleneck across kernels, compiler, runtime, and parallelism, and fix it at the right layer. Close the gap between model and measurement. Compare measured performance against analytical models and simulation. Explain every material gap, and turn the explanation into a fix or a better model. Build the agentic performance loop. Give agents the profilers, traces, counters, and benchmark harnesses to form a hypothesis, change code, and measure the result in minutes. Make the results trustworthy enough to act on. Set the bar for performance. Define how we measure, track regressions, and report results. Build for the next chip. Design abstractions that carry forward to future hardware generations. Work with hardware architects to test how architectural choices affect real workloads. What we need from you You understand hardware performance. You've optimized AI workloads on GPUs or custom accelerators and can reason about compute utilization, memory hierarchy, latency hiding, synchronization, and multi-chip scaling. You build excellent software. You've owned substantial systems from design through production. You're strong in Python and/or at least one systems language such as Rust, C++, or C, and rigorous about interfaces, abstractions, and testing. We care about engineering quality more than a specific language. You understand LLM inference end to end. You can read a new model's implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention variants, KV caches, MoE, and parallelism, and how they map to compute, memory, and communication. You build with agents. Agentic development is how you work, not an experiment. You'd rather build the loop that finds the optimization than find it by hand, and you know when the loop still needs a human. You build things others succeed with. You've designed APIs, libraries, or performance tooling that other engineers adopted. You drive problems to resolution. You form clear hypotheses, measure, and follow the evidence across software and hardware boundaries. You take ownership of the result. If you hit a few of those boxes, we'd like to speak to you. We'd be thrilled if you had Experience with embedded, bare-metal, or low-level runtime programming. Experience with MLIR, other compiler frameworks, or kernel DSLs such as Triton, Pallas, NKI, or CuTe. Contributions to LLM serving stacks such as vLLM or SGLang, or a track record of taking end-to-end inference workloads to competitive performance on a hardware target. Why join us Your code will decide how fast models run on our hardware, and how easy it is for the next engineer, or the next agent, to make them faster. You'll own a layer of a new programming model, work directly with the people designing the hardware, and see your decisions tested on real silicon and carried into the next generation. Tensordyne Values Think big. Pursue ambitious technical and business goals. Aim for excellence. Quality matters in everything we build and deliver. Own it and get it done. Take responsibility and drive results. Operate with integrity. Be direct, transparent, and respectful. Win as a team. Make the people around you more effective. Value different perspectives. The strongest teams challenge assumptions and bring diverse experience to difficult problems. Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. The role combines architecture and hands-on engineering: clean, object-oriented software, plus ownership of how it is built, deployed, updated and monitored across the fleet. Application development: Build Python services on top of the platform, inside our dockerized main application. Device integration: Connect peripherals such as modems, watchdogs, cameras and AI accelerators through existing drivers, SDKs and Linux interfaces, behind a clean hardware abstraction. Reliability and observability: Make our fleet secure, resilient and transparent through OTA updates, networking, inter-process communication and fleet-wide monitoring of device health. Ownership and mentoring: Take end-to-end responsibility, guide other engineers technically, and raise our engineering standards. Strong OOP skills: Deep experience with object-oriented design in (preferably) Python. Experience in another OOP language such as C++, Java or Rust is a plus. description: Du entwickelst Social Media bei Rosental Organics zu einem wirksamen Wachstums- und Umsatzkanal weiter. Du steuerst die Weiterentwicklung unserer Social-Media-Kanäle mit dem Ziel, den messbaren Umsatzbeitrag nachhaltig zu steigern. Hooks, Formate und Calls-to-Action testest du und skalierst, was nachweislich Reichweite, Kaufinteresse und Umsatz bringt – gemeinsam mit Marketing und E-Commerce. title: Sales Mitarbeiter – Teilzeit / Werkstudent
description: Unsere Mission Wir bei DeWarmte sind davon überzeugt, dass die Energiewende nur dann funktioniert, wenn sie für alle zugänglich und attraktiv ist. Dieser Kerngedanken leitet uns bei DeWarmte. Deshalb entwickeln und installieren wir unsere eigenen Wärmepumpen. So machen wir nachhaltiges Heizen intelligenter, bezahlbarer und für immer mehr Haushalte zugänglich. Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen und bauen aktuell unser Geschäft in NRW aus mit einem neuen Standort in Düsseldorf. Wir leben kurze Entscheidungswege, offene Kommunikation und einen starken Teamgeist. Dir wird Vertrauen und Verantwortung entgegengebracht – und gleichzeitig die Unterstützung, die du benötigst, um erfolgreich zu sein. Deine Aufgaben Wir wachsen rasant und immer mehr Menschen finden den Weg zu uns. Deshalb suchen wir eine/n Mitarbeiter/in für die Leadqualifizierung, der/ die dafür sorgt, dass jeder interessierte und bestehende Kunde schnell und kompetent betreut wird. Du stehst mit Kunden in Kontakt, hauptsächlich telefonisch und per Video. Du hörst gut zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und hilfst dem Kunden, den logischen nächsten Schritt zu gehen. Manchmal bedeutet das, einen Termin für eine digitale Inspektion zu vereinbaren. Manchmal stellt sich heraus, dass unsere Lösung nicht passt. Du musst bei deinem Einstieg kein Wärmepumpen-Experte sein. Wichtig ist uns jedoch, dass du neugierig bist, schnell lernst und Energie aus dem intensiven Kundenkontakt schöpfst. Du befasst dich mit: Telefonischer Erstkontakt zu potenziellen Kunden Nachverfolgung und Qualifizierung neuer Leads Bestehende Kunden bei Fragen weiterhelfen und für eine gute Nachbetreuung sorgen Gespräche und Termine ordentlich in unserem CRM-System erfassen Rückrufvereinbarungen und offene Aufgaben eigenständig nachverfolgen Erkennen, wo Kunden auf Schwierigkeiten stoßen, und diese Erkenntnisse mit dem Team teilen Dein Profil Für diese Position ist uns deine Arbeitsweise wichtiger als ein bestimmter Abschluss oder eine bestimmte Anzahl an Jahren Berufserfahrung. Du knüpfst leicht Kontakte, hörst gut zu, stellst gezielte Fragen und kannst Informationen auf einfache Weise erklären. Außerdem verfügst du über kommerziellen Ehrgeiz. Es macht dir Spaß, ein Gespräch in die richtige Richtung zu lenken und du traust dich, einen konkreten nächsten Schritt vorzuschlagen. Du bist überzeugend, ohne aufdringlich zu sein. Du findest schnell heraus, was jemand sucht, wie die Situation aussieht und ob es sinnvoll ist, den Prozess fortzusetzen. An einem geschäftigen Tag sprichst du mit verschiedenen Kunden. Das gibt dir eher Energie, als dass es dich abschreckt. Und du arbeitest strukturiert und selbstständig. Wenn du jemandem versprichst, am Donnerstag zurückzurufen, dann tust du das auch. Erfahrung im Vertrieb ist schön, aber sicherlich nicht der einzige Weg zu dieser Stelle. Vielleicht hast du im Inbound-Vertrieb, im Telefonverkauf, in einem Callcenter, in der Energiebranche oder in der Telekommunikation gearbeitet. Aber auch Erfahrungen im Gastgewerbe können sehr relevant sein, wenn du dort gelernt hast, schnell Kontakt aufzubauen, gut zuzuhören und kommerziell zu denken. Dabei helfen dir: Interesse an Technik und Nachhaltigkeit Erfahrung mit Beratungsgesprächen oder Videokonferenzen fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse Digitale Skills, z. B. im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen wie HubSpot Wir erwarten nicht, dass du vom ersten Tag an über technisches Wissen zu Wärmepumpen verfügst. Wir bringen dir bei, was du wissen musst. Wir erwarten jedoch, dass du neugierig bist und neue Informationen schnell aufnimmst. You own the evidence that our certification body reviews. If something is broken, you fix it. If something can be automated, you build it.

You will join the Safety & Compliance team in Munich, which is developing a new safety controller in-house while keeping the safety-software system on our robots today certified and moving forward. Verification has not had a dedicated owner so far, so you create the structure, the catalog and the process rather than only executing an existing one. You work daily with the safety (software) engineers and with TÜV to define what must be verified. Early on, you set up and prove the verification system for the current system, and you then carry it into the certification of the new controller.

  • Own the verification of our new safety controller end to end, from the verification plan to the certification evidence (target PL d per ISO 13849-1:2023 and SIL 2 per IEC 61508)

  • Build the complete verification catalog and set up the verification process and structure from scratch

  • Verify the safety software at unit and integration level with automated tests including fault and robustness cases, structural coverage, static analysis, and code and requirement reviews

  • Automate verification so that it runs on every change

  • Verify the controller and its safety functions as part of the robot arm against ISO 10218-1:2025

  • Keep traceability from risk assessment to test results and write reports that hold up in an audit

  • Work closely with the safety (software) engineers and TÜV to define what must be verified

  • Review the verification work of your colleagues and share your practices with the team

  • A degree in a technical field such as software, electrical or mechanical engineering, or equivalent experience

  • 3+ years of experience verifying or testing safety-critical embedded systems in industrial automation, automotive, rail, aerospace or medical devices

  • Enough embedded C to write white-box tests and to find defects in a code review

  • Working knowledge of IEC 61508-3 or its industry counterpart (ISO 26262-6, EN 50716, DO-178C) and the verification evidence it requires

    • Clear technical writing and fluent English (C1+); German is a plus

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

The Role

This is not a traditional procurement role. At Andercore, procurement is trading: fast-paced, market-driven, and executed daily — not on quarterly or annual cycles. You will lead a team of young and hungry category managers, through high-volume purchasing decisions in a dynamic environment where prices, availability, and supplier landscapes shift constantly.

You will own end-to-end procurement strategy and execution: sourcing, onboarding to the system, supplier negotiations and disputes, pricing, team leadership, and process design. We need someone who can think strategically and execute operationally every single day — from setting category strategy to approving individual purchase orders. You will be in the driver seat to build the first AI automated trading engine - a unique opportunity in the industrial supply space.

You report directly to the C level and sit on the commercial and operations leadership team. Andercore uses AI extensively across the business; you will be expected to leverage it to drive efficiency, margins, and scalability in procurement.

The core purpose of this role is to build one buying strategy that combines three things:

  • Spot trading, run as a repeatable system with a regular market-coverage schedule and clear KPIs;

  • Strategic buying, where you negotiate allocations, framework agreements and terms with Tier-1 manufacturers and develop private-label and direct-from-factory categories;

  • Supply planning, where you set the mix of spot, contract and stock and keep price and inventory risk under control.

Each part on its own is not enough. The job is to make them work together so that Andercore buys at the right price, secures supply when the market tightens, and never holds stock it cannot sell.

What You Will Do

  • Build and run the procurement machine: Develop and execute procurement strategies that support an 8-digit monthly procurement spend with exponential growth. Negotiate favourable terms, pricing, and contracts with suppliers on a daily basis.

  • Lead and develop the team: Manage 10+ team members, set clear priorities daily, coach emerging team leads, and create a culture of accountability and speed. You will need to be assertive and hands-on. Be the player-coach. Close deals yourself and hire the people you need to scale

  • Create scalable processes: Design, implement, and continuously improve procurement workflows, playbooks, and controls. Processes are implemented in days and weeks at Andercore — not quarters and years.

  • Own supplier relationships: Source, evaluate, and onboard suppliers. Maintain and expand a high-quality supplier network with strong retention across existing and emerging markets.

  • Drive margin improvement: Identify cost-saving opportunities, optimise purchasing decisions, and improve payment terms to boost net revenue margin and cash cycle.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Logistics, Accounting, and Product & Engineering to align supply with demand and ensure operational excellence.

  • Full P&L responsibility: for the supply side.

  • Leverage data and AI: Use data to inform purchasing decisions, monitor supplier performance, and identify market trends. Embrace AI tools to automate and scale procurement operations.

  • AI-native procurement: automate processes from RFQs through to order confirmations, with sellers as co-designers of the agents.

What Success Looks Like

  • Revenue and margin targets consistently met or exceeded through high availability and competitive pricing.

  • A robust, high-quality supplier network with strong retention and engagement across existing and emerging markets.

  • Streamlined, repeatable processes that reduce time-to-onboard, minimise errors, and allow the team to scale without linear headcount growth.

  • A high-performing, motivated team with emerging team leads and strong cross-functional collaboration.

  • Accurate, data-driven reporting that drives continuous improvement and informs executive strategy.

  • Run a category management that unlocks and owns new product lines

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from a top university or business school.

  • 4+ years in a high-performance environment: for example commodity trading / high-velocity B2B procurement.

  • Proven ability to build processes and delegate effectively. You must be able to create systems that outlast your personal involvement — not do everything yourself.

  • Strong assertiveness and people leadership. You will manage a young team that needs clear direction, daily prioritisation, and coaching.

  • Ability to operate at both strategic and granular levels: setting category strategy in the morning and reviewing individual POs in the afternoon.

  • Excellent analytical and communication skills.

  • Fluent English is required; German is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable with a high-intensity, fast-paced startup environment where priorities can shift daily.

  • Proven results negotiating from the smaller side of the table, i.e. securing allocation, pricing and terms when you are not the biggest customer.

  • Hard-working, proactive, and independent. Willing to go the extra mile to get the job done.

  • A personal track record in spot or commodity trading with margin ownership.

  • Experience scaling a team, plus forecasting and inventory risk management.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, SaaS, or construction / infrastructure / energy materials.

  • Exposure to AI-driven operations or automation of procurement workflows.

  • Familiarity with cross-border trade and international supplier management.

  • Tier-1 strategy consulting background (e.g. McKinsey, BCG, Bain).

This Role Is Not For You If…

  • Your procurement experience is in slow-cycle, enterprise purchasing (annual contracts, quarterly reviews). Our cadence is daily.

  • You are strong on analysis but weak on implementation. We need someone who executes, not just diagnoses.

  • You prefer to do things yourself rather than build teams and processes. Delegation and system-building are non-negotiable.

  • You need a fully structured environment to be effective. Here, you will create the structure.

What We Offer

title: UI Engineer (Based in CA or NC only)
description: Mission: Live at the intersection of app runtime & security. Protect applications in a fundamental way so that developers can build great application services and not be constantly looking over their shoulder. BlueRock is changing the landscape of App runtime security. The role Location: Must be based in CA (preferably San Francisco Bay Area) or North Carolina You will work alongside BlueRock's product designers and the control plane development team on our operator consoles. These are the React front ends that engineers and security teams use to manage large fleets of protected nodes, see what AI agents are actually doing across those fleets, and author the policy that constrains them. The domain is AI and agentic systems, seen from the operations and security side. When an agent calls an MCP server, spawns a subagent, runs a shell command in a sandbox, or burns $40 of tokens in an afternoon, our UI is where a person sees it, understands it, and decides what to allow. So the interesting problems are visibility problems (how do you show a thousand agent sessions so someone can find the one that matters?) and control problems (how do you author an enforcement policy without a mistake taking production down?). This is a mid-level role. We expect about 3–5 years of professional front-end experience, or equivalent work that clearly shows the same judgment. The ideal candidate is passionate about user experience, design, and AI-assisted software development, with a demonstrated grounding in engineering best practices. The title says UI, but the work doesn’t stop there: you’ll work closely with our backend services, and a feature is finished when it’s proven working live, not when the screen looks right. Working with design delivered as code At BlueRock, product designers design and collaborate in code. Instead of handing off static mockups, they build working UI with AI coding tools, against real data, and open merge requests. Iteration happens so quickly that it has outpaced our capacity for robust engineering collaboration and review. This role closes that gap. You will collaborate directly with product designers and backend developers to keep UI development fast, by bridging the gap between vibe code and high-quality, sustainable, well-tested code. Some days that means reviewing and hardening a designer's branch so it can merge. Other days it means building the shared components, tests and guardrails that make the next branch need less hardening. Beyond reviewing and hardening code, you'll help shape how it gets made. Working with designers and the AI tools they use, you'll turn what each review teaches us into shared components, conventions, tests and agent instructions. Over time the whole practice becomes more predictable, and each new branch arrives closer to production-ready. Roles and collaboration Software development roles are blurring more than ever. This role reports to product design, with API and data-layer guidance from our control plane engineering lead. You must be attuned to the perspectives of both UX/Design and Engineering, acting as a bridge between the goals and priorities of both sides, while ultimately deferring to UX/design partners on matters of style, copy, and information architecture. In practice: when a designer's branch makes a choice about layout, copy or flow, you protect the intent and fix the implementation. When the implementation can't support the intent, because of performance, data shape or maintainability, you say so early and bring options rather than quietly changing the design. What you'll do Review designer-authored merge requests and bring them to production quality: structure, types, tests, accessibility, performance, and both light and dark themes. Turn one-off UI from fast iteration into shared, documented components in our design system and Storybook, and migrate the apps onto them. Make data-dense views hold up at real scale. Dashboards, tables, charts, and time-range and filter controls that work on a demo tenant also have to work on one with billions of events. Wire UI to the API layer (GraphQL), and work with backend developers when a view needs a new query, field or endpoint. Own UI test coverage: Vitest for units and Playwright for end-to-end flows, kept green in CI. Test UI end to end in live, secured environments, with full authentication and authorization, real data and realistic load, before calling it done. Keep UI work moving across release lines: shipping behind feature flags, and carrying fixes between branches when a release is frozen. Fix UI bugs across the consoles and the Windows, Mac and Linux clients: layout and overflow, tooltips and popovers, empty and zero states, things that are technically correct and still confusing. When needed, design new interfaces within the existing design system, and bring them to design for review. Help set the guardrails that make AI-assisted UI development safe: lint rules, conventions, review checklists, and the instructions our AI coding tools follow. How we expect you to work These are the habits of a careful engineer. They matter more here, not less, because so much of the code you touch was drafted quickly by someone else or by an AI tool. Diagnose before you change. Find the actual cause, which is usually a layer away from the symptom, and be able to explain why your fix addresses it. A change that makes the symptom disappear is not the same as a fix. Small, deliberate diffs. Solve the problem in front of you. Don't refactor adjacent code on the way past, and don't build the abstraction you may need later. Fix it in one place. When the same bug shows up in three panels, the fix belongs in the shared component, not copied three times. Knowing where a change belongs is most of the skill. Verify, then claim. Run it, look at it, check both themes and a narrow viewport, get types and lint clean, and write the test where a test is what proves it. Then say plainly what you checked and what you did not. This applies double to AI-assisted work: you own the diff, whoever drafted it. Say when you're unsure. A requirement with two readings is a question, not a guess. Surfacing a problem early is always cheaper than discovering it in review. Our UI stack and design system Our front ends are several React and TypeScript apps that share one codebase: our enterprise operator consoles and our cloud product for builders. All of them are built on our own design system. It is a shared React component library on top of Ant Design, with design tokens for color, type and spacing, light and dark themes, and a shared app shell for navigation, page layout and headers. Every component is documented in Storybook, published from CI, which serves as the reference for designers, engineers and AI coding tools alike. The library also carries written instructions for AI coding assistants, so generated code reaches for the system's components and tokens instead of inventing its own. A large part of this role is the design system itself. That means promoting patterns out of individual apps into shared components, writing their stories, keeping tokens and themes consistent so the apps don't drift, and making the system the easiest path for anyone, or any agent, building UI. Front end: React, TypeScript, Vite Design system: our component library built on Ant Design, including design tokens and light and dark themes Documentation: Storybook, published to GitLab Pages Data and charts: GraphQL; ECharts for the data-dense views Testing: Vitest, Playwright, and contract and smoke suites in CI Delivery: GitLab merge requests and pipelines, release branches, feature flags Further back: TypeScript and Rust services over graph and columnar stores, built on OpenTelemetry, plus desktop apps and services across Mac, Windows and Linux You don't need experience with all of it. You do need to be strong in TypeScript and React, and willing to read code before changing it. What you bring About 3–5 years building production front ends in TypeScript and modern React: hooks, composition, state that lives at the right level, and an understanding of why a re-render happens. An end-to-end view of the systems behind the UI. Designing in code gets a feature most of the way to working, and you close the rest of the gap. For you, “done” doesn’t stop at the UI working. It means the UI is integrated and shown to work live, in a secured environment with full authentication and authorization, under realistic load. Integration testing against complex backends. Tests that only run against mock data in a standalone dev stack aren’t enough here. You can create, integrate and run tests in live environments to check data validity, load, security and scale, and you keep unit, integration and end-to-end suites green in CI. Performance instincts for data-heavy UI: pagination, virtualization, server-side filtering, and knowing when a slow page is a query problem rather than a rendering problem. A track record of reviewing other people’s code and improving it without rewriting it. Git in complex repositories with several active release branches, where a single fix may need to be cherry-picked, ported or graft-merged onto more than one of them. Readable commits, and responding to review without taking it personally. Hands-on use of AI coding tools in real work, with clear habits for checking what they produce. CSS that holds up: flexbox and grid, overflow and scroll containers, responsive behaviour, and why a tooltip or popover ends up clipped. Experience building or contributing to a component library or design system, ideally with Storybook and design tokens. Careful attention to visual detail and real interest in UX. Much of this work is noticing that something is two pixels wrong, or that a label is technically correct and still confusing. Genuine interest in the AI and agentic space, and in the operational and security questions it creates. Nice to have: Ant Design; GraphQL; ECharts or other charting libraries; design training or a portfolio; experience on a team where designers commit code; writing conventions or instructions for AI coding tools; desktop UI across Mac, Windows and Linux; dense operational tooling such as observability, security or infrastructure products. Not required: a computer science degree, if your work shows the same rigor. Deep backend, security or infrastructure expertise, or any knowledge of our domain (fleet management, telemetry, agent observability, policy enforcement). We will teach that. Your first 90 days First month: land changes safely. Ship scoped fixes in the consoles. Learn the component library, theme tokens and API layer. Start reviewing designer merge requests alongside an engineer. Second month: own review on a surface. Become the primary reviewer for designer-authored UI on one product area, and extract at least one repeated pattern into a shared component. Third month: make the next branch easier. Get the flows you own covered by tests in CI, and write down the conventions and guardrails that make designer branches need less hardening. About BlueRock: BlueRock is a well-funded, early stage cybersecurity company founded by experienced security minded entrepreneurs. Our mission is to change the game in cybersecurity. Attackers are exploiting in hours. The dependency tree is exploding. Developers are drowning in vulnerability debt. BlueRock changes the game, enabling organizations to shift from chasing CVEs and exploits to proactively protecting the foundations of applications and computing, so that developers can build great applications without looking over their shoulders.
