  • Test UI end to end in live, secured environments, with full authentication and authorization, real data and realistic load, before calling it done.

  • Keep UI work moving across release lines: shipping behind feature flags, and carrying fixes between branches when a release is frozen.

  • Fix UI bugs across the consoles and the Windows, Mac and Linux clients: layout and overflow, tooltips and popovers, empty and zero states, things that are technically correct and still confusing.

  • When needed, design new interfaces within the existing design system, and bring them to design for review.

  • Help set the guardrails that make AI-assisted UI development safe: lint rules, conventions, review checklists, and the instructions our AI coding tools follow.

How we expect you to work

These are the habits of a careful engineer. They matter more here, not less, because so much of the code you touch was drafted quickly by someone else or by an AI tool.

  1. Diagnose before you change. Find the actual cause, which is usually a layer away from the symptom, and be able to explain why your fix addresses it. A change that makes the symptom disappear is not the same as a fix.

  2. Small, deliberate diffs. Solve the problem in front of you. Don't refactor adjacent code on the way past, and don't build the abstraction you may need later.

  3. Fix it in one place. When the same bug shows up in three panels, the fix belongs in the shared component, not copied three times. Knowing where a change belongs is most of the skill.

  4. Verify, then claim. Run it, look at it, check both themes and a narrow viewport, get types and lint clean, and write the test where a test is what proves it. Then say plainly what you checked and what you did not. This applies double to AI-assisted work: you own the diff, whoever drafted it.

  5. Say when you're unsure. A requirement with two readings is a question, not a guess. Surfacing a problem early is always cheaper than discovering it in review.

Our UI stack and design system

Our front ends are several React and TypeScript apps that share one codebase: our enterprise operator consoles and our cloud product for builders.

All of them are built on our own design system. It is a shared React component library on top of Ant Design, with design tokens for color, type and spacing, light and dark themes, and a shared app shell for navigation, page layout and headers. Every component is documented in Storybook, published from CI, which serves as the reference for designers, engineers and AI coding tools alike. The library also carries written instructions for AI coding assistants, so generated code reaches for the system's components and tokens instead of inventing its own.

A large part of this role is the design system itself. That means promoting patterns out of individual apps into shared components, writing their stories, keeping tokens and themes consistent so the apps don't drift, and making the system the easiest path for anyone, or any agent, building UI.

  • Front end: React, TypeScript, Vite

  • Design system: our component library built on Ant Design, including design tokens and light and dark themes

  • Documentation: Storybook, published to GitLab Pages

  • Data and charts: GraphQL; ECharts for the data-dense views

  • Testing: Vitest, Playwright, and contract and smoke suites in CI

  • Delivery: GitLab merge requests and pipelines, release branches, feature flags

  • Further back: TypeScript and Rust services over graph and columnar stores, built on OpenTelemetry, plus desktop apps and services across Mac, Windows and Linux

You don't need experience with all of it. You do need to be strong in TypeScript and React, and willing to read code before changing it.

What you bring

  • About 3–5 years building production front ends in TypeScript and modern React: hooks, composition, state that lives at the right level, and an understanding of why a re-render happens.

  • An end-to-end view of the systems behind the UI. Designing in code gets a feature most of the way to working, and you close the rest of the gap. For you, “done” doesn’t stop at the UI working. It means the UI is integrated and shown to work live, in a secured environment with full authentication and authorization, under realistic load.

  • Integration testing against complex backends. Tests that only run against mock data in a standalone dev stack aren’t enough here. You can create, integrate and run tests in live environments to check data validity, load, security and scale, and you keep unit, integration and end-to-end suites green in CI.

  • Performance instincts for data-heavy UI: pagination, virtualization, server-side filtering, and knowing when a slow page is a query problem rather than a rendering problem.

  • A track record of reviewing other people’s code and improving it without rewriting it.

  • Git in complex repositories with several active release branches, where a single fix may need to be cherry-picked, ported or graft-merged onto more than one of them. Readable commits, and responding to review without taking it personally.

  • Hands-on use of AI coding tools in real work, with clear habits for checking what they produce.

  • CSS that holds up: flexbox and grid, overflow and scroll containers, responsive behaviour, and why a tooltip or popover ends up clipped.

  • Experience building or contributing to a component library or design system, ideally with Storybook and design tokens.

  • Careful attention to visual detail and real interest in UX. Much of this work is noticing that something is two pixels wrong, or that a label is technically correct and still confusing.

  • Genuine interest in the AI and agentic space, and in the operational and security questions it creates.

Nice to have: Ant Design; GraphQL; ECharts or other charting libraries; design training or a portfolio; experience on a team where designers commit code; writing conventions or instructions for AI coding tools; desktop UI across Mac, Windows and Linux; dense operational tooling such as observability, security or infrastructure products.

Not required: a computer science degree, if your work shows the same rigor. Deep backend, security or infrastructure expertise, or any knowledge of our domain (fleet management, telemetry, agent observability, policy enforcement). We will teach that.

Your first 90 days

  1. First month: land changes safely. Ship scoped fixes in the consoles. Learn the component library, theme tokens and API layer. Start reviewing designer merge requests alongside an engineer.

  2. Second month: own review on a surface. Become the primary reviewer for designer-authored UI on one product area, and extract at least one repeated pattern into a shared component.

  3. Third month: make the next branch easier. Get the flows you own covered by tests in CI, and write down the conventions and guardrails that make designer branches need less hardening.

Spezialisiertes Umsetzungsteam: Copywriting, Design und technische Implementierung werden durch erfahrene Kollegen unterstützt. Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Arbeite mit Experten aus E-Commerce, CRM und Retention-Marketing zusammen und entwickle deine strategischen Fähigkeiten weiter. Flache Hierarchien: Direkte Kommunikation, kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Fitnessstudio-Zuschuss: Wir unterstützen deinen sportlichen Ausgleich. Menschen, die ihre Kunden verstehen, ihre Zahlen kennen und den Anspruch haben, gemeinsam mit ihrem Team außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse zu erzielen. description: Was wir suchen Eine Person, die ihre Freunde als „technisch-affinen Menschenfreund“ beschreiben würden, und Lust darauf hat zu erklären und zu beraten. Aufgaben Kickoff: Du führst Kickoff-Calls per Video mit neuen Kunden und klärst, wie die Prozesse, die wir für sie automatisieren aussehen. Setup: Du richtest KI-Systeme nach unserem festen, dokumentierten Standard ein und verbindest ihn mit den Plattformen des Kunden, zum Beispiel Mail, Kalender und etc. Onboarding: Du begleitest den Kunden, bis alles rund läuft – mit Onboarding-Call und einer Woche Feedback-Runde. Support: Du betreust unsere bestehenden Kunden und antwortest innerhalb von 24 Stunden. Einen Großteil der Anfragen erledigt unsere KI, du kümmerst dich um den Rest. Kundenbeziehung: Du schreibst mit den Kunden, beantwortest Fragen und sorgst dafür, dass sie zufrieden sind 🤝 Produkt: Du sammelst Fehler und Kundenfeedback und gehst sie einmal pro Woche mit unserem Team durch, und wirkst aktiv an der Verbesserung unserer Produkte mit. Tempo: Nach der Einarbeitung betreust du mehrere Setups parallel und startest bis zu einen neuen Kunden pro Tag. So arbeiten wir dich ein Woche 1: Du lernst unsere Abläufe, unser Studio und den Setup-Standard kennen und baust deinen eigenen KI-Agenten, falls du noch keinen hast (inkl. aller relevanten Schulungen). Woche 2: Du bist bei Kickoff-Calls und Setups unseres Technik-Teams dabei. Ab Woche 3: Du führst deinen ersten eigenen Kickoff, und hast einen Mentor an deiner Seite, der dich dabei unterstützt. Nach rund 4 Wochen: Du machst Calls, Setup und Support eigenständig und übernimmst nach und nach immer mehr Eigenverantwortung. Qualifikation Du magst Technik und Menschen gleichermaßen und hast ggf. selbst mit KI-Werkzeugen wie Claude Code, Codex oder eigenen Agenten gearbeitet. Du telefonierst gern und erklärst Technik so, dass dich ein Schreinermeister und ein Geschäftsführer gleichermaßen verstehen. Du arbeitest sorgfältig und verantwortungsbewusst, gerade mit Kundendaten. Du willst Gas geben, dazulernen und persönlich wachsen. Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift (C2), denn unsere Kunden sind deutsche Unternehmer. Englisch hilft bei Dokumentation und Tools, ist aber keine Bedingung. Optional: Du wohnst im Umkreis von Düsseldorf oder München (unsere Standorte) Welcher Abschluss dahintersteht, ist uns egal. Unsere Abläufe sind dokumentiert und lernbar – du musst nicht alles von Anfang an können. Wer nicht zu uns passt: Jemand, der lieber nur am Code sitzt und Kundengespräche als Störung empfindet. Jemand, der Dienst nach Vorschrift sucht. Wir erwarten keine Dauerbereitschaft und kein Wochenende am Laptop, aber dass du Dinge zu Ende denkst und einen eigenen Anspruch an die Exzellenz deiner Arbeit hast ⭐ Wie geht's weiter? Kein Lebenslauf, kein 0815-Anschreiben. Beantworte ein paar kurze Fragen und beantworte in deinem Anschreiben in eigenen Worten (*nicht KI-geschrieben*): 1) Was hast du bisher selbst mit KI gebaut? 2) Welche KI-Themen interessieren dich aktuell am meisten als Lernfeld? 3) Warum könntest du der perfekte Fit für diese Rolle sein? title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description: Die Energiewirtschaft steckt mitten in der größten Transition ihrer Geschichte. Energieversorger, Netzbetreiber und Lösungsanbieter brauchen Software, die da mithält, und sie brauchen jemanden, der ihnen klar und glaubwürdig erklärt, warum epilot genau die richtige Plattform ist. Als Senior Product Marketing Manager bist du genau diese Stimme im Markt. Du gestaltest mit, wie wir epilot als zentrale, AI-native Plattform für die neue Energiewelt positionieren. Und du sorgst dafür, dass Marketing, Sales und Customer Success eine gemeinsame Geschichte erzählen. Product Marketing ist für dich das Fundament jeder Kommunikation und nicht nur der Lieferant für Slides und Battle Cards? Dann lies weiter. epilot ist das XRM für die Energiewirtschaft: Unsere Plattform verbindet nicht nur Kund:innen, sondern auch Partner, Installateure, Lieferanten und interne Teams. Über 200 Energieversorger und Netzbetreiber arbeiten bereits damit, und unser Team aus über 120 Menschen wächst weiter. Wenn du Teil dieser Journey sein und epilot an entscheidender Stelle voranbringen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Das erwartet dich Positionierung und Messaging der epilot Plattform liegen in deiner Verantwortung, für Energieversorger, Netzbetreiber und Lösungsanbieter. Produktfunktionen übersetzt du in Mehrwerte, die bei allen wichtigen Personas ankommen. Nah am Markt: In Sales-Calls, im Gespräch mit Kund:innen und auf Branchenevents erfährst du, was Energieversorger gerade umtreibt. Daraus hältst du ICPs, Personas und Wettbewerbsanalysen aktuell und machst sie zu Wissen, mit dem das ganze Unternehmen arbeitet. Produktkampagnen und Markteinführungen steuerst du inhaltlich, von der Story bis zu den Kernbotschaften, gemeinsam mit unserem Campaign & Growth Marketing. Auch die inhaltliche Qualität unserer Produktseiten und weitere produktnahe Inhalte liegt in deiner Verantwortung. Sales und Customer Success machst du sprechfähig: mit Pitch-Materialien, Argumentationshilfen, Einwandbehandlung und Trainings. AI-gestützte Workflows für Product Marketing baust du auf und entwickelst sie weiter, etwa für Persona- und Wettbewerbsanalysen, Messaging oder Sales-Materialien. AI ist für dich kein Knopfdruck: Die Logik dahinter entwickelst du selbst. Unsere Junior Product Marketing Managerin führst du fachlich und begleitest sie in ihrer Entwicklung. Strategy, Produktmanagement, Sales, Customer Success, Campaign & Growth sowie Event Marketing schätzen dich als Sparringspartner:in. Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Marketing , idealerweise im Product Marketing. Positionierung und Messaging hast du schon selbst verantwortet. Komplexe Produkte verstehst du schnell und erklärst sie einfach. Dabei findest du die Worte, bei denen Zielgruppen nicken, und nicht die, die nur intern gut klingen. Strategisch denken und selbst anpacken gehören für dich zusammen. Ein Messaging-Framework entwickelst du ebenso gern wie eine Produktseite oder einen Sales-Pitch. Auf ein Briefing wartest du nicht: Wo es eine klare Story braucht, bringst du sie auf den Weg. AI-Tools nutzt du nicht nur. Am liebsten baust du eigene Workflows, statt dich auf fertige Lösungen zu verlassen. Neugier auf die Energiewirtschaft ist entscheidend. Branchenerfahrung oder Wissen über Energieprozesse ist ein großes Plus, wichtiger ist aber deine Lust, tief einzutauchen. Überzeugungskraft: Stakeholder bis hin zum C-Level gewinnst du mit klaren Argumenten. Außerdem macht es dir Freude, andere fachlich zu begleiten und weiterzuentwickeln. Sprachen: Stilsicheres Deutsch auf C2-Niveau ist ein Muss, denn dein Messaging muss im deutschen Markt sitzen. Dazu sprichst du fließend Englisch, unsere Unternehmenssprache. Das bieten wir dir Flexibles Arbeiten: Remote arbeiten, wann immer es passt, und regelmäßig in Köln zusammenkommen, wenn persönlicher Austausch zählt. Die Möglichkeit, die erfolgreichste SaaS-Plattform auf dem Energiemarkt mit aufzubauen. Start-up-Mentalität: dynamische Atmosphäre und großartiger Teamspirit. Ein stark wachsendes Unternehmen mit offener Kommunikationskultur, motivierten Kolleg:innen, und internationaler Unternehmenskultur Exponentielle Lernkurve – epilot wächst rasant, selbiges erwarten wir von dir Einen zentralen und modernen Standort im Herzen von Köln mit coolen Cafés direkt um die Ecke Transparenz – Wir pflegen eine sehr flache und offene Unternehmenskultur, alles ist einsehbar und steht zur Diskussion. Regelmäßige Teamevents wie bspw. zu Karneval, das Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, Company breakfast und noch viel mehr Gelegenheiten deine epilot:innen auch außerhalb der Arbeitszeiten kennenzulernen Sportangebote wie Urban Sports Club, ein Gym um die Ecke u.v.m. Immer noch nicht überzeugt? Hier unser Versprechen an alle zukünftigen epilot:innen 💙 promise.epilot.cloud/ Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Herkunft, unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Alter, Behinderung oder sexueller Orientierung! P.S.: Falls du dir nicht sicher bist, ob diese Stelle noch offen sein sollte, dann schau einfach unter https://epilot.cloud/karriere/ (dort findest du natürlich auch alle weiteren offenen Positionen). Wenn sie dort noch online ist, dann suchen wir auch noch bzw. wieder ;). Also: worauf wartest du noch? Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

B. das Deutschlandticket), sowie Zugang zu einem Fahrrad-Leasing-Programm. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge in Zusammenarbeit mit Degura zur Absicherung deiner finanziellen Zukunft. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">About Crunchyroll</h2> <p>Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.</p> <p>Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!</p></div><h2>About the role</h2> <p>Crunchyroll is seeking a Senior Manager, CRM Marketing to lead localized CRM engagement for our European markets, one of our fastest-growing regions. Based in London, this role will own the CRM campaign calendar for the region, balancing high-velocity title moments and catalog beats while bringing our biggest anime moments to life across owned channels.</p> <p>You will plan and execute high-impact, fan-first campaigns that support title launches and catalog discovery—including new season/series drops, dub drops, mid-season arcs, and finales for top-tier titles. Success in this role requires strong segmentation and analytical judgment, plus the ability to translate IP into messaging that creates an emotional connection with fans.</p> <p>You’ll also act as a subject matter expert for the Europe market, championing transcreation and locally resonant storytelling (not just translation), cultural nuance, and fan-first engagement. You’ll partner closely with our global Lifecycle Marketing team that owns always-on lifecycle journeys; in this role, you will serve as a regional advisor and ensure key title moments and local insights are reflected in the broader lifecycle strategy.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>CRM Campaign Calendar Ownership: </strong>Own the CRM campaign calendar for Europe across tentpole releases, seasonal beats, and catalog programming, aligning timing, targeting strategy, and channel plans with local and global priorities (across multiple markets, languages, and time zones).<strong><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Go-to-Market Campaigns:</strong> Collaborate with regional marketing, brand, programming, and curation teams to design localized go-to-market moments for major content launches, seasonal events, partnerships, and fan activations.</li> <li><strong>Segmentation &amp; Audience Strategy:</strong> Apply best practices in personalization and segmentation to build targeted campaigns informed by fan behavior, affinities, regional nuances, and language/dub preferences. Partner with Data Science and Growth teams to refine audience definitions, identify opportunities, and improve precision over time.</li> <li><strong>Regional Market Expertise:</strong> Serve as Crunchyroll’s CRM market lead for Europe, advising on cultural nuances, local market behaviors, local platform norms, channel norms, and fan engagement opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Localized Lifecycle Strategy:</strong> Provide regional inputs into Europe lifecycle journey strategies across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and winback, working closely with our Lifecycle Marketing team. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.</p> <p>By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin,&nbsp;with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.</p> <p>THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;Cult Beauty</span></strong></p> <p>Cult Beauty is one of the UK's leading online beauty destinations, known for a curated, expert-led edit of the best emerging and established beauty brands. As part of THG, Cult Beauty combines an entrepreneurial, fast-moving culture with the scale, data and technology of a global e-commerce group. The affiliates and partnerships channel is a genuine growth priority for the business, with strong performance to date and significant headroom to scale reach, revenue and brand awareness over the next 12–24 months.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why be a Senior Paid Social Manager at THG Beauty?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>The Senior Paid Social Manager is responsible for developing and executing Cult Beauty’s paid social strategy to drive customer acquisition, engagement, and retention. This role is ideal for an experienced paid social specialist looking to take on greater strategic responsibility, budget ownership, and stakeholder engagement.</p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As<strong> Senior Paid Media Manager</strong></span><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>,</strong> you’ll:&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Budget &amp; Budget Management &amp; Forecasting</span></h2> <ul> <li>Manage the paid social marketing budget, tracking spend against the plan and identifying risks or opportunities.</li> <li>Own in-month and in-quarter forecasting of paid social spend and performance metrics.</li> <li>Provide evidence-led recommendations for budget allocation based on channel performance and strategic priorities.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">3. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.</p> <p>By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin,&nbsp;with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.</p> <p>THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader.&nbsp;</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}"><strong>About The Role</strong><br>This is an exciting opportunity for an established Senior CRM Manager to lead the LOOKFANTASTIC CRM team. This role is responsible for ensuring markets deliver against the overall CRM strategy, creating plans aligned with market maturity and business growth ambitions. Managing a CRM team of eight who have responsibility for the UK &amp; Ireland and EU regions, you will work closely with our marketing activation and trading teams to increase the CRM mix-of-business, drive customer activation and customer retention metrics.</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why be a Senior CRM Manager at THG Beauty?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>This is an exciting opportunity for an established Senior CRM Manager to lead the LOOKFANTASTIC CRM team. This role is responsible for ensuring markets deliver against the overall CRM strategy, creating plans aligned with market maturity and business growth ambitions. Managing a CRM team of eight who have responsibility for the UK &amp; Ireland and EU regions, you will work closely with our marketing activation and trading teams to increase the CRM mix-of-business, drive customer activation and customer retention metrics.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">As Senior CRM Manager</span><span data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;you’ll:&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1}">&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Deliver LOOKFANTASTIC’s CRM strategy across key CRM channels, including email and app push.</li> <li>Develop monthly CRM campaign plans, rooted in data and insights, to meet commercial targets whilst delivering an optimal customer experience. Ensure operational excellence in the team’s execution of these plans.</li> <li>Continually review the automations programme (workflows and triggers), monitoring and reporting on performance. Identify challenges and opportunities to improve performance ongoing, whether that be optimisations of existing and/or introduction of new workflows and automations.</li> <li>Lead Test &amp; Learn initiatives across markets: Planning, implementation and reporting of a regular testing framework across each CRM channel, aligned to overall strategy, to drive ongoing optimisations.</li> <li>Identify touchpoints for improvement and implement strategies to maximise customer satisfaction, retention and lifetime value. title: Product Manager
description: <p>At Dexory, we're developing advanced software powered by cutting-edge robots that are transforming the very face of global logistics. With infectious enthusiasm, our unique blend of disciplines work in harmony to produce results at pace. From hardware and manufacturing to software, AI and commercial, we're one team – one heart – that beats, learns and grows together.</p> <p>We're only interested in the best ideas, no matter where they're from. We're doers. Game-changers.</p> <p>Out-of-the-box thinkers who put merit before all else. A group of ambitious and disciplined individuals who are passionate about turning theory into rubber, metal and results.</p> <p>Only with immense heat and pressure are diamonds formed, and our high-performance, high-reward culture isnʼt for everyone. We bend the rules. We say it as it is. We donʼt quit. We keep ego and bureaucracy in check to help our operation stay agile and performing at its peak. We're a place where careers are defined, and we'll give you all the tools youʼll need to make your mark.</p> <p>This opportunity doesnʼt present itself everyday. This is your chance to be a part of something truly revolutionary.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The foundations for success have been laid, but we're only just getting started. Are you ready for the fight?</p> <p><em>*We value the right attitude, humility and we're as interested in your character as we are in your talent. Please apply, even if you feel you only meet part of our listed criteria. Diversity drives innovation and we offer an international and friendly work environment with an energetic company culture.</em></p> <p><br><br></p> <p><strong>Role:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Dexory, we are on a mission to be the most dominant player in warehouse intelligence globally. As a Product Manager, you will operate across multiple product streams under a clear vision, elevate execution standards and best practice, and turn customer and data insight into measurable business outcomes. You’ll be the connective tissue across engineering, design, research, commercial, and operations - raising the bar for strategy, delivery, and culture while helping coach other PMs to do their best work.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Scale strategy &amp; vision: Connect adjacent product areas under a coherent strategy and outcome-based OKRs; facilitate domain-level planning that influences company priorities.&nbsp;</li> <li>Drive execution excellence: Own delivery health across multiple product areas; remove systemic blockers; establish consistent planning, reporting and launch practices that others adopt.</li> <li>Champion data &amp; insight: Ensure every initiative has clear success metrics; run portfolio reviews; help teams move debates from opinion to evidence.&nbsp;</li> <li>Customer &amp; market leadership: Scale discovery standards; maintain senior customer relationships; ensure roadmaps tie to validated insight and commercial value.&nbsp;</li> <li>Influence &amp; alignment: Orchestrate complex stakeholder ecosystems; create clarity in ambiguity; communicate progress and trade-offs to senior leadership.&nbsp;</li> <li>Innovation &amp; growth: Build experimentation frameworks; scale what works; evaluate new opportunities that strengthen Dexory’s category leadership.</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p> <p><strong>Required Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years in Product Management with demonstrable impact in B2B platforms (automation, AI/ML, data or industrial domains a plus).&nbsp;</li> <li>Track record aligning multiple teams around a clear strategy and delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives to measurable outcomes.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong data fluency: defining KPI trees, running post-launch analyses/experiments, and leading portfolio-level reviews that inform investment.&nbsp;</li> <li>Depth in discovery: turning qualitative and quantitative insight into opportunity statements and roadmaps tied to commercial value.&nbsp;</li> <li>Exceptional stakeholder skills: influencing without authority, resolving high-stakes conflicts with empathy and evidence, and communicating at exec level.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience at the intersection of hardware and software, or deploying AI/analytics in operational environments is a bonus.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>We operate by four principles:</p> <p><strong>Performance. Impact. Commitment. One Team.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Joining Dexory isn’t just about having expertise… it’s about embracing uncertainty with purpose. You’ll</p> <p>help define not only our products, but the future of autonomous logistics itself. From day one, you’ll be</p> <p>trusted to push boundaries, take ownership, and deliver breakthrough results.</p> <p>You’ll also receive:</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>You will also receive:</p> <ul> <li>Share options</li> <li>Private healthcare via Bupa with 24/7 medical helpline&nbsp;</li> <li>Life insurance</li> <li>Income protection&nbsp;</li> <li>Pension: 4+% employee with option to opt into salary exchange, 5% employer</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme - mental wellbeing, financial and legal advice/support&nbsp;</li> <li>25 holidays per year&nbsp;</li> <li>Full meals onsite in Wallingford</li> <li>Fun team events on and offsite, snacks of all kinds in the office&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>AAP/EEO Statement &nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Dexory provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. It prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training</p> <p><strong>Please note: We are unable to provide sponsorship for this role.</strong></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Graduate Site Reliability Engineer (Australia)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><h3><strong>Your Impact</strong></h3> <p>As a contributor in the SRE organization, you are passionate about delivering solutions to the real-time problems our mission-critical cloud native services encounter. You are also obsessed about achieving the high quality and reliability our customers demand. You will work closely not only with the SRE division, but your technical deliverables will reach the entire engineering organization to enable product teams to continuously deliver features on the raw.title: Embedded Banking Financial Crime Oversight Lead
raw.description:
Trust unlocks our greatest potential.

For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution.

What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’.

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our Embedded Banking Financial Crime Oversight team as an Embedded Banking Financial Crime Oversight Lead? Reporting to the Head of Embedded Banking Financial Crime Oversight, you will coordinate thorough assessments of new Embedded Banking Partners to evaluate their financial crime controls, with emphasis on outsourced processes. You must understand their Operating Model, including systems, processes, and sub-contractors. After onboarding, you will monitor these partners' financial crime controls, assess risks using ClearBank’s taxonomy and relevant data, and ensure compliance with the Oversight model, including leading governance sessions.

Your role includes:

  • Ensuring and overseeing compliance with all internal policies, standards, industry guidance and regulation

  • Leading the completion of the Financial Crime Systems and Controls Assessments for all new Embedded Banking relationships in accordance with policies, standards, and procedures

  • Responsible for the monitoring and oversight of existing Embedded Banking Partners in accordance with standards and procedures from a financial crime perspective.

  • Ensuring all oversight activities are completed in accordance with the Oversight Model

  • Continuously assessing and updating financial crime aspects of Embedded Banking Partners Risk and Control registries

  • Defining and reporting internal and external Key Risk Indicators enabling data driven performance monitoring

  • Chairing all Embedded Banking Partner financial crime governance sessions where required

  • Responsible for maintenance of Embedded Banking Partner Management Procedures covering Onboarding & Oversight from a financial crime perspective

  • Supporting the delivery of relevant aspects of the Embedded Banking change programme

  • Supporting the development and implementation of new financial crime systems and controls

  • Building and maintaining knowledge of all relevant legislation, regulatory changes, and industry best practice

What you’ll bring:

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

  • Significant expertise in risk and control frameworks and compliance with regulatory standards specifically in relation to financial crime, especially in relation to outsourcing of those controls

  • Audit, assurance or consultancy background with significant experience in the oversight and review/assessment of the adequacy and effectiveness of financial crime control frameworks

  • Strong understanding of sectors such as money remittance, electronic money, APIs, Cryptocurrency firms, and merchant acquirers is a plus

  • Experience dealing with complex and varied business models

  • Self-starter, able to work independently when needed, and to prioritise tasks

  • Ability to communicate and negotiate with key stakeholders and customers

  • Strong attention to detail and good judgement

  • Work to tight deadlines, whilst maintaining high level of quality and competency

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities

Regretfully we are not able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes at the current time.

What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you?

  • You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank;

  • You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care;

  • You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate;

  • ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

What we offer in return:

  • We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.

  • Offices – Work in a way that works for you – whether that’s in the London office, at home, or hybrid.

  • Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus bank holidays.

  • Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.

  • Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the UK for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.

  • Socials – Regular social events open to all.

  • Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice.

  • Wellbeing – 24/7 employee assistance programme including mental health support, life assurance and income protection.

  • Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you.

  • Healthy living – Private healthcare and discounted dental cover, with employee perks and discounts.

  • Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave.

  • Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever!

Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation.

title: Product Manager - Internal Tools and AI
description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it Every promise our products make to a user or merchant is kept by an internal team somewhere in the company. When those teams can organise their work, adapt quickly and stay focused, Wave moves fast; when they can't, the company slows down and customers feel it. When we were smaller, organizing work didn't take much more than a quick spreadsheet but that breaks at scale. Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and the Gambia. We work with millions of users every month, employ thousands of people, and are growing rapidly. Similar processes now run in a dozen countries, but each team has built its own version, either because they don't know a better one exists or because setting it up well is harder than it should be. AI has made this both better and worse: anyone can now build a workflow in an hour, but many aren't secure, won't scale, cost too much, or automate a process that should have been simplified first. Your job is to think from first principles about how work at Wave should run, give people a consistent and safe way to improve their own workflows, and make the common ones easy to adopt. We're looking for a product manager who gets a kick out of figuring out how work should actually flow, and who doesn't much care whether the answer is a tool we build, a workflow in something we already pay for, or no tool at all. Someone who enjoys getting into the weeds with operations teams and who turns what they learn there into playbooks and building blocks every team can use. In this role, you'll... Own how Wave's general work tools get used. You're accountable for tools like Slack, Monday, and AI serving teams well. You work with the People team and other stakeholders to make sure they're set up so that organizing work or finding an answer is easy from day one. You help us make the right calls on major vendor decisions using what you've seen first-hand from users. Help operations teams use AI efficiently and safely. You find the use cases where it truly saves teams time and turn those into shared skills, bots, and templates others can pick up in minutes. You build with these tools every day and teach teams to build in a secure and affordable way. Care about the person, but solve for the company. There are far more problems than you can take on, so you pick the ones that help the most teams. You turn each solution into a playbook, template, or building block, and work through champions in every team to carry it forward. Make sure each problem gets solved the right way. You're the expert on how people organize work in general, but behind every workflow sits domain context, constraints, and sometimes a product tool that already fits. You work with the leaders and PMs in that domain to decide whether a process should be simplified, automated, or shouldn't exist at all. Build the team this work needs, starting with you. In your first few months you'll spend much of your time in-country with our operations teams as an IC, setting up workflows yourself with Slack and Monday.com, creating Claude skills and writing the first playbooks. As you learn more about what the company needs you can help us form a team around you. Key Details This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA, Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso Wave is a distributed team, and we fund up to three in-person get-togethers a year, in line with Wave's travel policy. Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per quarter. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product. Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary between $142,200 - $203,300 USD, plus a generous equity package. Major benefits: Subsidised health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country). 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidised fertility assistance. Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year.  $10,000 annual charitable donation matching. Requirement 5+ years of experience in product management, or in a similar role where you owned products or processes end-to-end, ideally in high-ownership, fast-paced environments like scale-ups. Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and improving operational workflows that save teams time, produce accurate results, and run reliably at a reasonable cost. AI-fluent: you've used tools like Claude or ChatGPT to build skills, automations, or workflows that did something meaningful in your actual job, not just experiments. Speak fluent English Bonus if you Speak at least conversational French Have worked with Slack and an enterprise workflow tool like Monday, Jira or Linear. Have worked in or closely with large operations teams (support, field, finance) Are a mobile money user in Sub-Saharan Africa You might be a good fit if you Resonate deeply with how we do product and have experience working that way. Are a strong communicator that can inspire and lead by influence. Are great at coordinating across teams and excel at communicating across multiple cultures. Have a good nose for user-focused product design and obsess over user experience. Take ownership for outcomes and do whatever you can to make them close to inevitable. Have strong instincts for asking questions that could move the needle. Have the courage and persistence to replan when feedback or new information arrives. Always listen with empathy but ruthlessly prioritize based on impact. Are excited about travel and meet users where they are — your users will be in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and other countries in Africa, and some travel will be essential. About Product at Wave Product has always been very important to us at Wave, starting from day one with two very strong product-minded founders. Product Managers play a central role in our organization, impacting large chunks of the company around them, similar to the founders they were shaped after years ago. Our approach to building products may not be what you've seen in other places. Our processes are lightweight, informed by principles instead of methodologies and our PMs don't just manage backlogs full of polished tickets. Read our write-up on product at Wave! If you're excited to own a real problem end-to-end, set your own goals, and guide a team toward outcomes that matter for real people, you'll feel right at home here. If that's you, we'd love to meet you.   Our team We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world. We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most. We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production. We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa. We are on  Y Combinator's top companies by revenue . How to apply Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role. We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals. Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. Every promise our products make to a user or merchant is kept by an internal team somewhere in the company. When those teams can organise their work, adapt quickly and stay focused, Wave moves fast; when they can't, the company slows down and customers feel it. When we were smaller, organizing work didn't take much more than a quick spreadsheet but that breaks at scale.

Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and the Gambia. We work with millions of users every month, employ thousands of people, and are growing rapidly. Similar processes now run in a dozen countries, but each team has built its own version, either because they don't know a better one exists or because setting it up well is harder than it should be.

AI has made this both better and worse: anyone can now build a workflow in an hour, but many aren't secure, won't scale, cost too much, or automate a process that should have been simplified first. Your job is to think from first principles about how work at Wave should run, give people a consistent and safe way to improve their own workflows, and make the common ones easy to adopt.

We're looking for a product manager who gets a kick out of figuring out how work should actually flow, and who doesn't much care whether the answer is a tool we build, a workflow in something we already pay for, or no tool at all. Someone who enjoys getting into the weeds with operations teams and who turns what they learn there into playbooks and building blocks every team can use.

In this role, you'll...

    • Own how Wave's general work tools get used. You're accountable for tools like Slack, Monday, and AI serving teams well. You work with the People team and other stakeholders to make sure they're set up so that organizing work or finding an answer is easy from day one. You help us make the right calls on major vendor decisions using what you've seen first-hand from users.
    • Help operations teams use AI efficiently and safely. You find the use cases where it truly saves teams time and turn those into shared skills, bots, and templates others can pick up in minutes. You build with these tools every day and teach teams to build in a secure and affordable way.
    • Care about the person, but solve for the company. There are far more problems than you can take on, so you pick the ones that help the most teams. You turn each solution into a playbook, template, or building block, and work through champions in every team to carry it forward.
    • Make sure each problem gets solved the right way. You're the expert on how people organize work in general, but behind every workflow sits domain context, constraints, and sometimes a product tool that already fits. You work with the leaders and PMs in that domain to decide whether a process should be simplified, automated, or shouldn't exist at all.
    • Build the team this work needs, starting with you. In your first few months you'll spend much of your time in-country with our operations teams as an IC, setting up workflows yourself with Slack and Monday.com, creating Claude skills and writing the first playbooks. As you learn more about what the company needs you can help us form a team around you.

Key Details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA, Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso
  • Wave is a distributed team, and we fund up to three in-person get-togethers a year, in line with Wave's travel policy.
  • Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per quarter. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary between $142,200 - $203,300 USD, plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidised health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidised fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year. 
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirement

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, or in a similar role where you owned products or processes end-to-end, ideally in high-ownership, fast-paced environments like scale-ups.
  • Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and improving operational workflows that save teams time, produce accurate results, and run reliably at a reasonable cost.
  • AI-fluent: you've used tools like Claude or ChatGPT to build skills, automations, or workflows that did something meaningful in your actual job, not just experiments.
  • Speak fluent English
  • Bonus if you
    • Speak at least conversational French
    • Have worked with Slack and an enterprise workflow tool like Monday, Jira or Linear.
    • Have worked in or closely with large operations teams (support, field, finance)
    • Are a mobile money user in Sub-Saharan Africa

You might be a good fit if you

  • Resonate deeply with how we do product and have experience working that way.
  • Are a strong communicator that can inspire and lead by influence.
  • Are great at coordinating across teams and excel at communicating across multiple cultures.
  • Have a good nose for user-focused product design and obsess over user experience.
  • Take ownership for outcomes and do whatever you can to make them close to inevitable.
  • Have strong instincts for asking questions that could move the needle.
  • Have the courage and persistence to replan when feedback or new information arrives.
  • Always listen with empathy but ruthlessly prioritize based on impact.
  • Are excited about travel and meet users where they are — your users will be in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and other countries in Africa, and some travel will be essential.

About Product at Wave

Product has always been very important to us at Wave, starting from day one with two very strong product-minded founders. Product Managers play a central role in our organization, impacting large chunks of the company around them, similar to the founders they were shaped after years ago.

Our approach to building products may not be what you've seen in other places. Our processes are lightweight, informed by principles instead of methodologies and our PMs don't just manage backlogs full of polished tickets. Read our write-up on product at Wave!

If you're excited to own a real problem end-to-end, set your own goals, and guide a team toward outcomes that matter for real people, you'll feel right at home here.

If that's you, we'd love to meet you.

 

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Offerings vary by location.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Twilio thinks big. Do you?</strong></p> <p>We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/values">Twilio Magic</a>. Additionally, we empower employees to build <a href="https://twilio.org/support-and-resources/impact-fund">positive change in their communities</a> by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.</p> <p>So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! title: Senior Product Designer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.</p></div><p><strong>About the Product team&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a Product Designer to join us in supporting our post-purchase experience and international expansion. Design serves a vital role at Affirm: from building narratives through data to creating products that help people make important financial decisions. As a designer, you are responsible for crafting experiences that build trust, confidence and deliver on our principles of honest, transparent financial products.</p> <p>We’re at a critical inflection point in Affirm’s journey, with millions of people engaging with our products and new opportunities to expand how they use Affirm every day. We’re also growing globally, reaching new customers in new geographies every day.&nbsp;</p> <p>This Product Designer will help shape our post-purchase experiences, as well as building the next new geographies that Affirm will expand into. You can demonstrate a breadth of design experience leveraging your ability to create delightful experiences that simplify our customers’ payment management experience through Affirm as well as contributing to our wider international expansion strategy. You’ll partner well with design leadership, design research, and content design. You’ll work end-to-end, from contributing towards Design and Product vision to delivering class leading design. You are able to work closely with Product and Engineering to tailor unique customer experiences for our merchants &amp; consumers while ensuring cohesion to the core Affirm experience - championing our customers needs no matter where their journey starts.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Lead end-to-end design for key initiatives within our UK and international experiences, as well as our post purchase experiences globally, across App and Web. You’ll be driving from discovery through to delivery and iteration—achieving meaningful customer and business outcomes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own complex flows and ambiguous problem spaces, defining clear problem statements, success metrics, and design direction.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner closely with product, engineering, and data to make informed trade-offs and deliver intuitive, high-quality experiences.</p> </li> <li> <p>Balance speed and quality, making pragmatic decisions while contributing to a cohesive product experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Use research, data, and experimentation to inform decisions and continuously improve outcomes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Contribute to design systems and patterns, strengthening consistency and scalability across your area.</p> </li> <li> <p>Facilitate alignment and decision-making, ensuring teams move forward with clarity.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support and mentor other designers, helping raise the quality of work across the team.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What we look for</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Strong Craft &amp; Execution: You consistently deliver polished, thoughtful interaction and visual design with high attention to detail.</p> </li> <li> <p>Product Thinking: You balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints to make sound design decisions and improve end-to-end experiences.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ownership &amp; Initiative: You take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive work forward with minimal oversight.</p> </li> <li> <p>Cross-functional Collaboration: You build strong partnerships, communicate clearly, and help teams align on decisions and trade-offs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Data-Informed Decision Making: You use research, experimentation, and analytics to guide your work and iterate toward better outcomes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Team-Level Influence: You’re a trusted design partner within your area, contributing to direction and improving how the team works.</p> </li> <li> <p>Growth &amp; Adaptability: You seek feedback, continuously improve your craft, and leverage modern tools—including AI—to accelerate your workflow.</p> </li> <li> <p>Tools &amp; Experience: Proficiency with modern design and collaboration tools (Figma, G Suite, Notion, etc.).</p> </li> <li> <p>5+ years of product design experience or equivalent practical experience.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Why You'll Love Working Here</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>You’ll design financial products that genuinely help people.</p> </li> <li> <p>You’ll work on high-impact experiences used by millions of customers.</p> </li> <li> <p>You’ll join a team that values craft, collaboration, and thoughtful iteration.</p> </li> <li> <p>You’ll have the opportunity to grow your scope, influence, and leadership over time.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a remote-first position based in the UK with the option to work from our London office for candidates who prefer an office environment.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Base Pay Grade: L</p> <p>Equity Grade: UK 5</p> <p>Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, and job-related skills.</p> <p>Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness, and tech spending, and benefits including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. In addition, employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc.</p> <p>GBR base pay range per year<strong>: £<span data-formula-id="_c_f_4zYZFddFQ5_0" data-error="false" data-placeholder="false" data-loading="false" data-recalculating="false" data-inactive="false">101,000</span>&nbsp;-&nbsp;<span data-formula-id="_c_f_4zYZFddFQ5_1" data-error="false" data-placeholder="false" data-loading="false" data-recalculating="false" data-inactive="false">149,000</span></strong></p> <p>Location: Remote UK</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><strong>Remote-first with flexibility built in</strong><strong><br></strong>Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.</p> <p><strong>Benefits designed for you</strong><strong><br></strong>Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:</p> <ul> <li>Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.</li> <li>Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.</li> <li>Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.</li> <li>Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.</li> </ul> <p>We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.</p> <p>For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.</p> </div> <div> <p>By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's&nbsp;<a href="https://www.affirm.com/global-candidate-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Global Candidate Privacy Notice</a> and consent to the use of your personal information as described.</p> </div></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Consultant (Enterprise Modernisation Architect)
description: <div class="description content"> <p>The Solution architect for Enterprise Modernization in Europe is a senior subject matter expert responsible for technical excellence, solution integrity, and capability development within the service line.</p> <p>This hands-on role leads high-impact client engagements, contributes to pre-sales and solution design, and ensures the regional adoption and evolution of service-specific delivery frameworks, tools, and best practices. The role brings deep expertise in modernization strategies and execution in large legacy systems modernization programs, serving as a trusted technical advisor to both clients and internal teams. This role is key to ensuring delivery quality, enabling service adoption, and evolving the technical maturity of the offering.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li>Provides technical guidance on Enterprise Systems Modernization.</li> <li>Supports delivery teams in solving complex client problems.</li> <li>Contributes to solution design, proposals, and pre-sales activities.</li> <li>Develops and refines service accelerators and reference architectures.</li> <li>Mentors engineers and architects within the service domain.</li> <li>Acts as a bridge between delivery teams and global service development.</li> <li>Measures success by technical quality, asset adoption, and talent uplift.</li> <li>Requires 10+ years of experience in software engineering or technical consulting.</li> <li>Requires 3+ years in Enterprise Systems Modernization advisory.</li> <li>Focuses on technical depth in modernization strategies and enterprise solution architecture.</li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <br> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>Experience supporting solution design and technical delivery in complex enterprise environments.</li> <li>Proven ability to build, extend, and support delivery tools, frameworks, and reusable assets.</li> <li>Deep technical expertise in modernization strategies, cloud architecture, and platform thinking.</li> <li>Strong engineering skills, architecture patterns knowledge, and toolchain understanding.</li> <li>Excellent communication to translate technical insights into actionable business decisions.</li> <li>Collaborative with mentorship abilities and solution-oriented with asset contribution commitment.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>10+ years in software engineering, platform delivery, or technical consulting roles.</li> <li>3+ years in a subject matter expert or senior technical advisory role within Enterprise Systems Modernization.</li> <li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.</li> <li>Certifications in relevant platforms, tools, or frameworks for the Enterprise Systems Modernization domain.</li> <li>Experience contributing to internal accelerators, open-source projects, or client-aligned IP development.</li> <li>Familiarity with enterprise transformation programs and the consulting delivery lifecycle.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning &amp; Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> </div> </div> <h2 id="responsible-ai-use">Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</h2> <div class="responsible-ai-use content"> <p>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.<br><br>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.<br><br>We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full <a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment" target="_blank">Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment</a>.</p> </div> <h2 id="about">About Thoughtworks</h2> <div class="about content"> <p>Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.</p> </div> <p style="display: none;">#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: center;"><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment">See here our AI policy.</a></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
