description: <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>Build the test strategy that protects Graphcore’s system software releases at scale.</p> <p>As a Staff System Software Engineer, you will shape integration and system testing across firmware, BMC and Linux device drivers. Your work will help create a high quality gate for system software release packages.</p> <p>You will design, build, automate and report tests across complex server class systems. You will also develop reusable tools, pipelines and packaging solutions that help teams move faster with confidence.</p> <p>This role needs deep low level software knowledge and strong system thinking. You will own hard technical areas, guide best practice and stay close to the code.</p> <p><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p>You will join a new integration and system test team within System Software QA. The team verifies integrated components across BMC, firmware and Linux device drivers.</p> <p>Work happens close to the hardware, across component teams and QA. You will partner with developers, consult package stakeholders and turn use cases into robust system tests.</p> <p>Decisions are shaped by evidence, clear technical reasoning and ownership. You will be expected to speak up, act fast and raise standards through hands-on leadership.</p> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <p>· Strong experience in low level system testing and integration across complex software and hardware layers.<br>· Deep understanding of RTOS, complex boot logic, Linux and device drivers.<br>· Test development capability using Python and C/C++.<br>· Experience working with hardware, debuggers, CI/CD pipelines and build or integration tools.<br>· Ability to debug cross-layer issues and drive root-cause investigations to lasting corrective actions.<br>· Clear communication skills, with the ability to mentor engineers and document complex technical decisions.</p> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</p> <p><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></p> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</p> <p>Ready to build the tests, tools and release gates that help Graphcore deliver trusted system software? title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>Own the test strategy that proves Graphcore’s next generation drivers are production-ready.</p> <p>As a Staff System Software Engineer, you will shape how Graphcore validates complex device drivers and platform tools. You will bring technical depth across Linux kernels, drivers and systems software.</p> <p>Your work will help raise the quality bar for products that support the next generation of AI compute. You will influence design decisions, guide test infrastructure and drive reliability across the stack.</p> <p>You will design, build, execute and report tests across component, system and acceptance levels. You will debug difficult issues using hardware and software tools, simulators and emulators.</p> <p>This is a hands-on technical leadership role with broad reach. You will help teams move quickly while protecting production quality.</p> <p><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p>The Drivers QA team verifies low-level kernel drivers, user-space libraries and platform tools. Work spans component tests, user acceptance and full system validation.</p> <p>You will work directly with driver developers, hardware, firmware, ML stack, Kubernetes and cloud management teams. Decisions are made close to the technical detail, with engineers expected to speak up and own outcomes.</p> <p>The team values engineers who think big, act fast and take responsibility. You will mentor others, raise standards and turn hard system problems into lasting improvements.</p> <p><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p> <p>· Deep experience validating Linux kernels, device drivers or similar systems software<br>· Strong C++ and Python test development skills<br>· Experience with CI/CD, build tools and modern automated testing practices<br>· Ability to debug complex issues across hardware, firmware, drivers and upper software layers<br>· Proven ownership of technical work, priorities and delivery in an agile engineering setting<br>· Clear communication skills, including the ability to document and explain complex technical concepts</p> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. title: Senior Board Test Engineer
description: <h2>About the job</h2> <p>Turn board design insight into reliable tests that detect manufacturing defects in Graphcore’s hardware.</p> <p>As a Senior Board Test Engineer in Bristol, you’ll develop manufacturing tests for Graphcore’s advanced electronic products. You’ll focus on printed circuit board assemblies and the faults that affect their operation.</p> <p>Your work will help improve defect coverage across the test and inspection tools used by contract electronics manufacturers. You’ll help the team detect and manage hardware faults arising during manufacturing and product use.</p> <p>You’ll analyse PCB designs for testability and manufacturing risks, then develop boundary scan and embedded functional tests. You’ll also diagnose complex electronic faults down to component level.</p> <p>The role takes your test solutions beyond development, through deployment and support in factory and field environments.</p> <h2>The team and culture</h2> <p>The Product Test and Diagnosis team detects and manages hardware defects across chips, boards and finished systems. Its work covers manufacturing sites and products in the field.</p> <p>You’ll work closely with Hardware Design and Manufacturing Operations, linking design analysis with manufacturing test needs. You’ll also work with software, silicon design and external board test partners on complex hardware problems.</p> <h2>What we’re looking for</h2> <ul> <li>Strong electronics fundamentals and experience in manufacturing test for advanced electronic systems.</li> <li>Understanding of PCB manufacturing, surface-mount assembly, failure mechanisms, and automated optical and X-ray inspection capabilities.</li> <li>Experience developing JTAG 1149 boundary scan test solutions.</li> <li>Awareness of bed-of-nails testing (ICT/MDA) and high-volume in-system or on-board programming techniques (ISP/OBP).</li> <li>Ability to solve problems in complex electronic systems and diagnose defects down to component level.</li> <li>Clear communication and the ability to work with internal engineering teams and external board test partners.</li> </ul> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation.<br><br></p> <h2><strong>Job Summary</strong>&nbsp;</h2> <p>We are looking for a Principal Architect to define and drive the architectural vision of the software stack for the Graphcore ML accelerator.</p> <p>In this role, you will shape the architecture of our software ecosystem and maintain a deep understanding of the product’s hardware and software components, their interfaces, and how they interact.</p> <p>You are an excellent communicator, and you proactively convey the software architecture.</p> <p>You bring a pragmatic, trade-off-aware approach to decision-making, fully recognising the impact of architectural choices on product direction and engineering outcomes.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>The Team</strong>&nbsp;</h2> <p>The software architecture team is responsible for defining, maintaining and communicating the overarching architecture of our software stack, from firmware to ML frameworks.</p> <p>The team works within the wider software organisation, partnering closely with engineering teams who deliver against this architectural vision.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities and Duties</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Define &amp; document the software architecture of the software stack. &nbsp;</li> <li>Work across different software domains to ensure a coherent end too end architecture.</li> <li>Clearly communicate the software architecture to engineering teams.</li> <li>Ensure teams understand key software architectural components, interfaces, and guiding principles.&nbsp;</li> <li>Continuously maintain the software architecture as the product evolves. Communicate architectural changes proactively to all relevant stakeholders.&nbsp;</li> <li>Stay informed about trends and developments in the ML/software ecosystem.</li> <li>Assess the architectural impact of new technologies.</li> <li>Be aware of the usability, performance, reliability, maintainability, testability, security and observability constraints on the software architecture.&nbsp;</li> <li>Prototyping and validating architectural concepts through proof-of-concept implementations.&nbsp;</li> <li>Contribute to future and/or related product definitions with a forward-looking mindset, understanding and communicating the impact of future direction on software architecture.&nbsp;</li> <li>Work with the HW and Silicon architects to ensure product the needs of software stack.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ensure the software architecture meets the product requirements. &nbsp;</li> <li>Work closely with engineering, product, leadership, and partners to ensure alignment between business goals and architectural direction.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Candidate Profile</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Essential:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Expertise in one or more of these technologies; Firmware, Drivers, ML frameworks (PyTorch, Triton, etc), Collectives, HPC, Tooling, C &amp; C++, CPU architectures.</li> <li>Technical expertise in the ML accelerator software space.</li> <li>Excellent communication skill, both written and verbal.&nbsp;</li> <li>Collaborative mindset and ability to influence.&nbsp;</li> <li>Pragmatic approach to decision making, being very aware of trade-offs and implications.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desirable</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Demonstrable experience in a previous architecture role.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension (matched up to 5%), life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We offer a range of healthy food and snacks at our central Bristol office and have our own barista bar! We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.</p> <p><em>Applicants for this position must hold the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately at this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support for visa applications</em></p> </li> </ul> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="135" data-end="148"><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p data-start="150" data-end="247">Turn complex manufacturing data into higher yield, stronger quality and better products at scale.</p> <p data-start="249" data-end="481">As Principal Product Engineer, you will help Graphcore manufacture advanced products with optimised yield, quality and cost. You will guide product performance through launch, production ramp and sustained high volume manufacturing.</p> <p data-start="483" data-end="663">Your work will influence chip manufacturing, test, PCBA and system level production. You will help teams find the signals that improve reliability, reduce cost and protect quality.</p> <p data-start="665" data-end="875">You will partner with OSATs, test engineering, manufacturing, quality, data engineering and analytics teams. Together, you will release new products and solve difficult yield, test and manufacturing challenges.</p> <p data-start="877" data-end="1058">This role suits someone who enjoys deep technical ownership and practical impact. You will turn manufacturing data into action across silicon, boards, blades and rack scale systems.</p> <p data-start="1060" data-end="1080"><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p data-start="1082" data-end="1276">You will join the Product Test and Diagnosis team within Manufacturing Operations. The team spans Bristol, Cambridge, India, the US and Taiwan, working close to products and production partners.</p> <p data-start="1278" data-end="1462">Work happens through direct ownership, technical depth and clear decisions. You will define best practice, challenge assumptions and move quickly when yield or quality needs attention.</p> <p data-start="1464" data-end="1653">The team connects silicon, board level assemblies, server blades and rack scale systems. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p data-start="3744" data-end="3755"><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p data-start="3757" data-end="3913">Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p data-start="4224" data-end="4506">As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p data-start="4508" data-end="4830">Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</p> <p data-start="4832" data-end="4990" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">If you want to turn manufacturing insight into better products at scale, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to help shape product engineering at Graphcore.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Post-Silicon Validation
description: <p>Graphcore is a globally recognized leader in Artificial Intelligence computing systems. The company designs advanced semiconductors and datacentre hardware that provide the specialized processing power needed to drive AI innovation, while delivering the efficiency required to support its broader adoption.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, we are working to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure that its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p>We are developing the next generation of AI compute, a large-scale system-on-chip (SoC) designed to power future high-performance AI systems. As the Director of Post Silicon Validation, you will be responsible for leading the Bristol team, enabling pre-production software to run reliably on new silicon quickly and efficiently, before showing that the silicon meets the highest standards of quality, reliability and functionality, ready for production deployment.</p> <p>Reporting to the Senior Director of Post Silicon Validation, you will manage, develop and grow the Post Silicon Validation team in Bristol, delivering post-silicon validation across the full AI SoC, working across silicon, firmware, and platform levels. The role requires a deep technical understanding, strong hands-on debug experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively with hardware, software, and systems engineering teams.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Manage, develop and grow the Post Silicon Validation team in Bristol: </strong>The Post Silicon Validation team is relatively new, with a strong remit and growing quickly to help Graphcore bring up new silicon quickly and effectively.</li> <li><strong>Play a significant role in the definition, planning and execution of chip bringup activities: </strong>Develop and refine the overall post-silicon validation approach for our AI SoCs, ensuring reliable and timely delivery of validated silicon, architectural correctness, feature robustness, and at-scale system reliability.</li> <li><strong>Drive cross-domain debug and issue resolution: </strong>Lead investigation and resolution of complex issues spanning silicon, firmware, operating systems, and platform interactions. Ensure that fixes are effective and sustainable.</li> <li><strong>Promote collaboration and shared understanding: </strong>Work closely with design, software, and validation teams to align on quality objectives and debug priorities. Use data-driven insights and clear communication to maintain focus and alignment across teams.</li> <li><strong>Advance automation and scalable validation: </strong>Encourage the use of emulation, prototyping, and large-scale validation infrastructure to improve coverage and reduce time to debug.</li> <li><strong>Support continuous improvement: </strong>Foster a culture that values learning, transparency, and improvement in validation methods, automation, and analysis.</li> <li><strong>Engage with leadership and partners: </strong>Provide clear and concise updates on validation progress, risks, and quality indicators to executive teams and key partners. Contribute to product readiness assessments and roadmap decisions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Essential skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Building and running high performing teams</li> <li>A systems thinker, comfortable working across hardware, software, and integration boundaries</li> <li>A collaborative leader who builds trust and alignment across diverse teams</li> <li>Skilled in technical problem solving and debugging complex post-silicon issues</li> <li>A clear communicator who can simplify complexity and support sound decision-making in fast-paced environments</li> <li>Committed to developing people and promoting an inclusive, high-performing team culture</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Electronic Engineering or equivalent; Master’s preferred</li> <li>20+ years in silicon, system, or platform validation, including 10+ years in technical leadership</li> <li>Proven experience leading post-silicon validation and bring-up for complex SoCs (AI, GPU, or CPU)</li> <li>Strong understanding of SoC architecture, coherency protocols, power management, and interconnects</li> <li>Expertise in debug tools, DFT infrastructure, and validation automation frameworks</li> <li>Proficient in C/C++, Python, and Linux-based environments; experience with large-scale validation clusters is an advantage</li> </ul> <p>Benefits</p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension, life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
About Sidetrade

Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us. 

Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion: Aimie Video

The role

As a Senior Project Manager, you run enterprise Order-to-Cash implementations from contract signature to go-live and into run. You own the plan, the coordination and the project governance. You deliver on time, on budget, and with a customer who is ready to use what we built.

You join a Customer Experience team that holds its accounts from signature into renewal, alongside a Functional Expert, a Data Engineer and a Customer Success Manager. The customer keeps the same team throughout. You also arrive as we redesign implementation with AI, so you help shape how we deliver, not just follow it.

Requirements

What you will do:

  • Run the project from kickoff to hypercare: plan, governance, weekly status calls and steering committees with finance leadership up to CFO.
  • Deliver workshops on data mapping, integration and process design, train the customer to run UAT, and coordinate cutover, go-live strategy and business hypercare.
  • Deliver against the baseline date agreed with the customer and the SOW budget, and keep the burn visible.
  • Keep the commercial hygiene tight: billing milestones raised on time, change requests spotted and priced, effort tracked against the SOW.
  • Coordinate the customer's finance, IT and ERP teams with our Functional Experts and Data Engineers through integration, testing and go-live.
  • Lead complex programs, including multi-entity and phased rollouts, with several projects running in parallel at different phases.
  • Raise risks early and bring a plan with them. Take the hard conversation on a slipped date or a scope dispute.
  • Hand over to the Customer Success Manager at the transition into run, with the context Support needs.
  • Keep phase, risk and milestones accurate in Salesforce and our project tools.
  • Work with the AI agents that speed up our implementations, and check what they produce.

What you will bring:

  • 6+ years managing B2B SaaS, ERP or finance-system implementations, with enterprise projects that went live and stayed live.
  • A strong command of project economics: SOW, budget, burn, change requests, billing milestones.
  • Comfort in front of finance leadership, up to CFO, with good news and bad.
  • Order-to-Cash, credit, collections or accounts receivable knowledge, or the proven ability to pick it up fast.
  • The ability to hold several projects at different stages at once without dropping any of them.
  • The candor to say the uncomfortable thing early, to the customer and to Sidetrade.
  • Fluent English and French. German or Spanish is an advantage.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related field.

Why Sidetrade

  • AI-native. We are not a software vendor bolting AI onto a legacy product. Aimie IQ and our AI agents are built on the largest proprietary Order-to-Cash Data Lake.
  • Measurable impact. You work with enterprise finance teams on problems tied directly to cash and working capital.
  • Build the method. You join as we redesign implementation with AI, so you help shape how we deliver, not just follow it.

Benefits

  • Hybrid work model – a flexible mix of in-office and remote days
  • Great culture – active Social Club organizing regular team events and activities
  • Health & wellness – medical coverage, life insurance, and other wellness programs
  • Time off – competitive paid holidays plus public holidays
  • Career growth & compensation – competitive salary, equal opportunities, Edenred card, learning & mentorship programs, and advancement support

Because when you thrive, we all succeed! 

We’re committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive experience for every candidate.

If you need any accommodation during the hiring process, just let us know. 

Agencies 

We only accept applications from invited agencies via our Workable portal. Unsolicited CVs sent to managers or HR won’t be subject to fees.

title: Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique
description: Quandela est un leader mondial de l’informatique quantique, qui conçoit, développe et déploie des solutions quantiques de pointe à destination de la recherche et de l’industrie. Son offre comprend notamment les ordinateurs quantiques les plus économes en énergie pour les data centers, des solutions complètes de calcul quantique accessibles via le cloud, ainsi que des services d’accès à des algorithmes pour les acteurs académiques et industriels. Avec une feuille de route pragmatique et progressive, Quandela déploie depuis 2023 des systèmes de niveau industriel, tout en développant les futures générations d’ordinateurs quantiques tolérants aux pannes, capables de passer à l’échelle grâce à l’intégration de milliers de composants photoniques. Quandela ambitionne de rendre l’informatique quantique accessible au plus grand nombre afin de contribuer à résoudre les défis industriels et sociétaux les plus complexes. En savoir plus : Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Rejoignez-nous à la pointe de l’innovation en informatique quantique 🚀 À propos du poste Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de production et d'intégration de processeurs quantiques photoniques (QPU), nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique pour rejoindre notre équipe Assemblage & Production, basée à Massy. Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Ces opérations impliquent la manipulation de composants sensibles et délicats , nécessitant une grande précision, de la méticulosité et une attention particulière aux conditions de montage et d'intégration. Vous réaliserez les opérations de montage, de câblage, de thermalisation, de mise en service et de contrôle, en veillant au respect des contraintes cryogéniques et des protocoles de validation. Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our People team at Mirakl, a global team of around 30 people covering the full employee lifecycle across all of our offices worldwide. Together, you'll be contributing to building an exceptional employee experience and shaping the future of how Mirakl grows, learns, and develops its talent.
 

2. Your Impact

  • Coordinate learning events — Organise Manager Days, hackathons, bootcamps, lunch & learns and show-and-tell sessions, owning logistics, invitations, materials and post-event follow-up from start to finish.
  • Track participation and feedback — Manage attendance, collect feedback and synthesise key learnings and improvement opportunities to continuously raise the bar on our learning programmes.
  • Curate learning content — Audit and structure existing AI, enablement and learning resources into clear, audience-specific learning paths that make it easy for every Miraklian to grow.
  • Create practical resources — Develop guides, FAQs, checklists and quick-reference materials that support learning adoption and make knowledge accessible across the organisation.
  • Support AI fluency initiatives — Gather and document AI use cases, design surveys and knowledge checks, and organise assessment data to help the People team make informed decisions.
 

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's level degree in HR, from a business school or university
  • Experience in HR or learning is a plus, but not a prerequisite. Hybrid profiles combining analytical skills and project management are welcome.
  • Comfortable organising events and facilitating sessions, in connection with the projects mentioned.
  • Availability for a 6-month internship starting in January 2027 is required.
Skills:
  • Rigorous and autonomous, with strong tracking and reporting capabilities
  • Genuine interest in AI
  • Appetite for project management, data analysis and cross-functional collaboration
  • Strong communication skills in French and English
 

4. Tools Used

  • Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Collaborative tools (e.g. Notion, Google Workspace, or equivalent)
 

5. Languages

  • French: Fluent (C2 level required)
  • English: Professional proficiency (B2 minimum, C1 preferred)
 

6. Compensation, Perks & Benefits

  1. Pay Range: €1,200 – €1,400 per month, based on your level of study.

  2. Perks & Benefits:

    • A workplace that supports well-being and balance: breakfasts, fitness and yoga classes, after-work events, game nights
    • Mentoring from senior technical experts and regular feedback to support your growth
    • Immersion in a collaborative, international team passionate about sharing knowledge
    • 2 remote work days per month
    • Access to Works Council discounts (tickets, etc.)
    • Gymlib pass for your well-being
    • Modern offices in the heart of Paris (near the Eiffel Tower)
    • Swile meal vouchers
    • Transportation covered (50% Navigo, bike, etc.)
 

7. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  1. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter, followed by an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.
  2. Interview with our recruiter to discuss your profile and expectations
  3. Interview with your future manager
  4. Structured interview using the STAR method to ensure transparency and fairness
  5. Welcome to Mirakl! 🎉

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

title: CDI - Senior Product Engineer - Paris
description: <p><strong>Mission</strong></p> <p>Ce que vous construisez ne reste pas à l’état de démonstration : de vrais utilisateurs, au sein de grands groupes, s’en servent chaque jour. Applications et agents se conçoivent et s’exploitent en binôme avec l’AI Product Manager. Une équipe sinistres retrouve ainsi sur un seul écran les documents utiles et un brouillon de réponse ; ailleurs, un processus de commande ne demande plus aucune ressaisie manuelle.</p> <p><strong>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que de vrais utilisateurs s’appuient sur ce que vous livrez.</strong></p> <p>Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Product Engineer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Activités et responsabilités</strong></p> <p>À chaque projet, l’AI Product Manager pilote le produit avec le client : ce qui se construit en premier, et la vérification que les utilisateurs s’en servent, se décident à deux.</p> <p>Autour de l’application, trois métiers se croisent : les AI Engineers pour le comportement du modèle, les Platform Engineers pour le déploiement, les Context &amp; Analytics Engineers pour les données dont l’application a besoin. Les tests se font avec les utilisateurs finaux, le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Construire des applications métier : front end, back end et API.</p> </li> <li> <p>Intégrer des agents et des assistants dans un processus métier, avec des contrôles humains là où ils comptent.</p> </li> <li> <p>Automatiser des processus de bout en bout.</p> </li> <li> <p>Intégrer un modèle dans un outil que les équipes utilisent déjà.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire les connecteurs dont le cas d’usage a besoin, par exemple un serveur MCP pour un outil métier.</p> </li> <li> <p>Concevoir l’expérience utilisateur de l’IA : quand une personne valide, comment afficher les sources et l’incertitude.</p> </li> <li> <p>Définir avec l’AI Product Manager les évaluations propres au cas d’usage et les suivre en production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Assumer ce que vous livrez après la mise en production : monitoring, incidents, adoption.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Profil recherché</strong></p> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li> <p>Vous avez construit des applications avec un front end, un back end et des API, même si votre expertise est plus marquée d’un côté.</p> </li> <li> <p>Du code testé, relu et documenté, en Python, TypeScript ou dans un langage similaire.</p> </li> <li> <p>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</p> </li> <li> <p>Des besoins d’utilisateurs transformés en une première version, puis améliorée à partir de leurs retours.</p> </li> <li> <p>Le monitoring, les incidents et l’adoption font, pour vous, partie du métier.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une aisance à expliquer vos choix techniques à des personnes non techniques.</p> </li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plus, pas un prérequis :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Une expérience de construction d’agents ou d’assistants au-dessus d’un LLM : appel d’outils, orchestration.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience de conception de parcours avec validation humaine (human-in-the-loop) ou d’interfaces d’IA.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience d’intégration à des logiciels métier, comme un ERP ou un CRM.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience au contact des clients.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler</strong> : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</strong></p> <p>Entre le produit, l’interface et le modèle, le Product Engineer occupe le point où l’IA rencontre ses utilisateurs. Leurs réactions s’observent directement, et chaque version livrée tient compte de ce que les usages ont révélé.</p> <p>Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.</p> <p>Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.</p> <p>Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.</p> <p>Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.</p> <p>Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : conception d’agents, évaluation par cas d’usage, expérience utilisateur de l’IA, avec l’appui des AI Engineers et de la communauté Product Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Product Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).</p> <p>Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme le chapter AI Product Manager.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Processus de recrutement</strong></p> <p>Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.</p> <ol> <li> <p><strong>Entretien RH</strong> (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Appel avec le CTO</strong> (15 à 30 min, à distance).</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Screening technique</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Code review et live coding</strong> (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Cas technique</strong> (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Entretien final</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.</p> </li> </ol> <p>Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Rémunération </strong>: 60 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 6 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.</em></p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

techniques à des personnes non techniques.</p> </li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plus, pas un prérequis :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Une expérience de construction d’agents ou d’assistants au-dessus d’un LLM : appel d’outils, orchestration.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience de conception de parcours avec validation humaine (human-in-the-loop) ou d’interfaces d’IA.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience d’intégration à des logiciels métier, comme un ERP ou un CRM.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience au contact des clients.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler</strong> : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</strong></p> <p>Entre le produit, l’interface et le modèle, le Product Engineer occupe le point où l’IA rencontre ses utilisateurs. Leurs réactions s’observent directement, et chaque version livrée tient compte de ce que les usages ont révélé.</p> <p>Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.</p> <p>Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.</p> <p>Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. raw.title: Product Marketing Manager
raw.description:
About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

About the Role

The Product Marketing Manager will own how Nabla positions, launches, and drives adoption of the product with clinicians across their entire journey — from onboarding and activation through engagement and retention.

This is product marketing where the message ships directly to the user. You own the narrative for every new feature launch, then own the in-app and email programs that turn that narrative into activation.

You'll define the segmentation, write the positioning, ship the campaigns, and measure whether they actually moved adoption.

Userpilot is in place, but everything around it still needs to be built: the activation and adoption strategy, in-app and email templates, segmentation, cohort analysis, the process with Product Marketing peers, CSM, PM, and Design, and the campaign calendar.

This is a hands-on, highly operational PMM role. We need someone who lives in the tools, is data-driven, can test fast, structure the process, and turn usage insights into concrete positioning and messaging decisions.

Userpilot is the first step. Over time, this person will take ownership of the full communication stack across email, in-app, and other channels. The role works extremely closely with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, and Product Ops.

Nabla serves two distinct audiences, and lifecycle programs must work for both:

  • Self-serve clinicians, who discover, activate, and adopt the product largely on their own. Here, automated email and in-app communication carries most of the relationship — your messaging is the go-to-market motion.

  • Mid-market and enterprise health systems, managed by CSMs. Here the human relationship leads, and your programs must arm and reinforce the CSM — giving them timing, context, and content, never working around them.

You'll design each lifecycle so the right channel leads for each segment. On top of this, healthtech is a highly regulated industry with demanding clients: every communication must meet a high bar for accuracy, security, and professionalism, while still feeling personal and useful to busy clinicians.

Responsibilities

Feature Launch Positioning & Activation

  • Own weekly in-app launch communication for new features, end to end and at a fast cadence

  • Define the positioning and messaging for each release — what it is, why a clinician should care, what changes in their day

  • Design the in-app experience (placement, format, flow) for each launch

  • Validate messaging with Product Marketing peers, PM, and Design before shipping

  • Launch on time and coordinate across the relevant teams

  • Track performance (reach, engagement, adoption) for every launch and iterate quickly on results

  • Stay highly reactive to the product roadmap, turning new releases into clear, well-timed clinician communication

Lifecycle Strategy and Execution

  • Own the full lifecycle strategy across onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention, ensuring each stage of the practitioner journey is intentional, personalized, and measurable

  • Tailor segmentation, messaging, and cadence to the distinct needs of each segment:

    • For self-serve, build automated email and in-app programs that drive activation, adoption, and retention with minimal human touch

    • For mid-market and enterprise, build programs that complement and support CSMs

  • Direct and execute creative strategy for lifecycle channels — briefing, reviewing, and optimizing copy and design for brand consistency and message effectiveness

  • Build and maintain a clear campaign calendar across functions

Experimentation and Analytics

  • Lead a rigorous experimentation roadmap: A/B and multivariate testing of messaging, creative, cadence, segmentation, and value propositions

  • Define and own lifecycle KPIs, building reporting frameworks and sharing regular performance insights with marketing and cross-functional leadership

  • Partner with Data and Analytics on audience segmentation, behavioral signals, and AI-driven insights to enhance personalization at scale

  • Turn cohort and usage insights into concrete messaging and product-marketing actions

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, Product Ops, Clinical, and Brand to align lifecycle programs with broader business goals and the practitioner experience

  • Establish a clear, repeatable process across Product Marketing, CSM, PM, and Design for planning and shipping campaigns

  • Ensure all programs are developed and executed in compliance with HIPAA and applicable federal and state laws, partnering with Legal and Compliance as needed

Operations and Tooling

  • Take ownership of the full communication stack, starting with Userpilot

  • Evaluate and manage lifecycle marketing technology partnerships, recommending optimizations as we scale

  • Build and maintain process documentation, campaign playbooks, and training materials on internal platforms

  • Leverage AI tools as a core part of daily work (drafting, research, iteration) to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making

What We Are Looking For

  • 3-5 years in B2B product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or product-led growth marketing, including hands-on ownership of in-app channels

  • Proven ability to craft positioning and messaging for product launches and to ship it yourself, not hand it off

  • Deep expertise across the full post-signup funnel (onboarding, activation, engagement, retention)

  • Strong Product DNA, with sharp attention to user workflows and the details that shape the product experience

  • Strong strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to translate complex data into clear hypotheses, actionable insights, and business recommendations

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; ability to manage stakeholder expectations, influence without authority, and build alignment across diverse teams

  • Track record of building and scaling programs that drove measurable growth in adoption, engagement, and retention

  • Comfortable in a highly regulated, high-stakes industry (healthtech) with demanding clients, where accuracy, security, and compliance are non-negotiable

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Userpilot and HubSpot

  • Familiarity with Looker, Tableau, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar

  • Experience in a regulated industry: healthcare, behavioral health, or health-adjacent

  • Experience with AI-powered personalization, segmentation tools, or ML-informed campaign optimization

  • Experience marketing to a professional or clinical end user

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Pelico's customers feel one pain above all: missing parts that block delivery. The Solution squads are where we turn Pelico's platform into a product that fixes it.   • Ship the surface. Compose configuration, compute, widgets, connectors, and agents into customer-facing workflows that pass a real acid test on real customers.

  • Stay configuration-first. Solve in Phoenix YAML wherever you can, reach for code only when it's worth it, and never let the surface fragment into per-customer forks.

  • Set the bar. Author specs, run the spec-driven workflow, and put eval and review gates on anything AI-assisted that touches a customer.

  • Harvest the field. Spot the patterns that recur across accounts and turn them into platform capabilities, so the next customer is faster.

  • Lead by example. Write the code, pair with your squad and the engineers deploying at customer sites, raise the bar, and grow the team as the impact you ship earns it.

Own a surface well and you make Pelico's revenue engine both faster and more defensible — and you keep it from collapsing into bespoke work that can't scale.

About You

This is a lead-by-example role for a senior full-stack engineer with real product and customer judgment. You're energized by shipping outcomes under real constraints, you decide what not to build, and you lead by being in the code with your team.

You'll need:

  • A track record of shipping customer-facing product software end to end, full-stack, under real delivery pressure

  • Strong, current hands-on coding — we build in Kotlin / Java 25 (backend) and TypeScript / React (frontend); strong in one and credible across, or a fast learner

  • Product and customer judgment — scope to outcomes, cut to MVP under deadline, decide what not to build

  • A configuration-first, anti-bespoke instinct — you build for many customers, not one fork at a time

  • A track record of leading engineers by example, not by leaving the keyboard

  • You actively embrace AI tools as part of how you work — curious about what's possible and quick to adopt new ways of working smarter and faster.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows — whether for writing, research, analysis, coding, or productivity — and a genuine interest in staying at the frontier of what these tools can do.

Nice to have:

  • Aerospace / defense / supply-chain / discrete-manufacturing context (MRP, BoM, coverage, MRO/TAT, program management, procurement)

  • Forward-deployed / solutions-engineering / customer-embedded experience, feeding learnings back into a platform

  • Configuration- or low-code-driven product experience (YAML/DSL, composable UI, workflow authoring)

  • AI-native ways of working (agentic workflows, eval on AI output, spec-driven development)

  • French is a plus, not a requirement

description: PRENEZ LES COMMANDES DE NOTRE PERFORMANCE COMMERCIALE ! Manager de terrain, leader dans l'âme, vous aimez faire progresser vos équipes et relever de nouveaux défis ? Le Groupe Degenève , distributeur des marques Toyota et Lexus en Haute-Savoie, recherche son/sa futur/e Chef des Ventes VN/VO Multisites . Rattaché(e) directement au Directeur de Plaque, vous pilotez et animez l'activité commerciale Véhicules Neufs et Véhicules d'Occasion de plusieurs concessions. Votre rôle est central : fédérer les équipes, développer les performances et garantir une expérience client à la hauteur de nos marques. VOS MISSIONS FÉDÉRER, PILOTER, PERFORMER ! MANAGER ET DÉVELOPPER LES TALENTS Encadrer, animer et fédérer les équipes commerciales VN/VO des différents sites. Accompagner les conseillers commerciaux sur le terrain et développer leurs compétences. Organiser l'activité, fixer les priorités et assurer le suivi des résultats. Participer au recrutement, à l'intégration et à la formation des collaborateurs. DÉVELOPPER LA PERFORMANCE COMMERCIALE Déployer la stratégie commerciale en collaboration avec le Directeur de Plaque. Piloter les objectifs de ventes, de marges et de produits périphériques. Analyser les indicateurs et mettre en œuvre les actions nécessaires pour atteindre les objectifs. Optimiser la gestion, la rotation et la rentabilité des stocks VN/VO. Renforcer les synergies commerciales entre les concessions. Veiller au respect des standards Toyota et Lexus. PLACER LE CLIENT AU CŒUR DE LA RÉUSSITE Garantir une expérience client de qualité, de la prise de contact à la livraison. Accompagner les équipes dans les négociations et les situations complexes. Développer la satisfaction et la fidélisation de nos clients. VOTRE PROFIL UN LEADER DE TERRAIN, UNE CULTURE DU RÉSULTAT. Vous disposez d'une expérience réussie en management commercial , idéalement en tant que Chef des Ventes VN/VO dans la distribution automobile. Vous savez conjuguer exigence de performance, proximité avec vos équipes et sens du collectif. Ce qui fera la différence : Un leadership naturel et une réelle capacité à fédérer. Une solide maîtrise des enjeux économiques et commerciaux d'une concession. Un véritable talent pour accompagner et faire progresser les collaborateurs. We build a foundation model for architectural design that generates compliant, editable building layouts from scratch. The Role

We are looking for a AI Researcher to lead this effort in our Paris office. What you'll own:

  • Model Architecture & Design Space: Design the core model architecture and work on a discrete design space for architectural layouts. You will choose how to represent floorplans (e.g. as graphs of rooms/connections or token grids) such that the diffusion model’s outputs are editable and code-compliant by construction. This involves ensuring the model can enforce architectural rules (e.g. room sizes, adjacency constraints) within its generation process.

  • Large-Scale Model Training: Lead the training of a foundation diffusion model from scratch on GPU clusters. You’ll set up distributed training across multiple nodes, optimize data loading and checkpointing, and manage experiments at scale. The role requires hands-on engineering for efficient training of large models on high-performance computing infrastructure.

  • Benchmarking & Iteration: Evaluate the model’s performance and establish benchmarks to measure success. Using these evaluations, you’ll iterate on the model to push performance beyond existing methods. Our goal is to surpass the latest research results and produce genuinely useful architectural designs.

What We’re Looking For

  • Applied Research Excellence: PhD or Master’s in Maths, Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Strong foundations in ML and a track record of innovative research, publications, or high-impact projects.

  • Diffusion Model Expertise: Deep understanding of diffusion models (discrete or continuous), guided generation techniques, and the latest advances in generative modeling.

  • Large-Scale Model Training: Proven experience training large-scale deep learning models on GPU clusters. Comfortable with distributed training, multi-node jobs, experiment management, and handling large datasets.

  • Technical Engineering Skills: Proficiency in Python with experience in PyTorch or similar frameworks. Ability to write efficient, maintainable code and optimize training pipelines. Familiarity with distributed training libraries (e.g., PyTorch Lightning) is a plus.

  • Research Literacy: Ability to read, evaluate, and implement advanced ML research. You stay current with state-of-the-art generative modeling work and can adapt cutting-edge methods to domain-specific problems.

  • Industry Experience: Background in a top AI research organization or cutting-edge startup, especially working on foundation models or generative AI tools.

You're joining a team of 12 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours.

  • Build what no one has before: the foundation model that automates architectural design and redefines how cities are imagined, designed, and built.

Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. title: Senior Business Analyst / System Engineer CCS – Europäische Standardisierung EU-Rail (50%)
description: Im Rahmen des europäischen Projekts «Europäische Standardisierung CCS-Strecke» arbeiten gemeinsam mit führenden internationalen Bahnindustrieunternehmen wie Siemens, Hitachi, Alstom und CAF sowie europäischen Infrastrukturbetreibern wie DB, SNCF, RFI, ÖBB, Network Rail und ProRail an der Weiterentwicklung und Harmonisierung zukünftiger Bahnsysteme. Das Projekt ist Teil des Europe’s Rail Joint Undertaking (ERJU) und umfasst den System Pillar sowie den Innovation Pillar. Ziel ist die Entwicklung europaweit einheitlicher Betriebsprozesse, Systemarchitekturen und technischer Spezifikationen für die zukünftigen ERTMS-Zielsysteme, insbesondere ETCS Level 2 und Automatic Train Operation (ATO GoA 1/2). Die erarbeiteten Standards bilden die Grundlage für zukünftige europäische Betriebsvorschriften sowie für die Weiterentwicklung und Beschaffung von Sicherungsanlagen. Zur Unterstützung der internationalen Projektarbeiten suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Senior Business Analyst / System Engineer im Bereich Control, Command and Signalling (CCS). System Engineering: Erarbeitung und Weiterentwicklung von Systemdefinitionen, Systemarchitekturen und technischen Systemspezifikationen im sicherheitsrelevanten Bahnumfeld (CCS). Spezifikationserstellung: Entwicklung und Abstimmung von System- und Schnittstellenspezifikationen unter Berücksichtigung der Gesamtarchitektur sowie zukünftiger Bahnprozesse. Prozesskoordination: Verantwortung für die effiziente Umsetzung und kontinuierliche Optimierung der Arbeitsprozesse (Workstations) zur Erstellung der Systemspezifikationen. Operative Projektunterstützung: Unterstützung bei der Organisation, Koordination und Umsetzung der internationalen Arbeitsorganisation. Qualitätssicherung: Sicherstellung einer konsistenten, vollständigen und qualitativ hochwertigen Integration der Arbeitsergebnisse in die übergeordneten Systemspezifikationen. Stakeholder-Management: Zusammenarbeit und Abstimmung mit internationalen Industriepartnern, europäischen Infrastrukturbetreibern sowie internen und externen Fachspezialisten. Standardisierung: Mitwirkung bei der Entwicklung europäisch harmonisierter Betriebsprozesse und technischer Standards für zukünftige ERTMS-Systeme. Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (ETH, Universität oder Fachhochschule) in Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Fachgebiet. Umfassende Kenntnisse des Bahnsystems, insbesondere des Bahnbetriebs und der Zugsteuerung. Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich internationale Standardisierung im Bahnumfeld. Fundierte Erfahrung in der Erstellung von System- und Schnittstellenspezifikationen im europäischen Umfeld. Erfahrung mit Application Lifecycle Management Tools, insbesondere Polarion. Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Inhalte verständlich und zielgruppengerecht zu vermitteln. Sicheres Auftreten im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen nationalen und internationalen Stakeholdern. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. raw.description:
About the Role

The Destinus Industralization team is seeking an Industralization Engineer to help brining products from R&D to full scale production. The role requires expertise in balancing process and product optimization throughout the development cycle of the project as well as sound and realistic assessment where the improvements will bring the most impact in the given timeline.

The ideal candidate takes ownership of their work, leads by example and understands that approach to industrialization should be agile to fit best the fast-paced projects.

• Enable R&D team to implement DFX from the beginning of the project.

• Review and optimise existing and new processes of assembly and manufacturing to assure repeatable quality of products.

• Find and audit suitable suppliers and manufacturers.

• Set up suppliers and manufacturers as partners.

• Establish and maintain communication with suppliers to enable manufacturing R&D, Batch Zero and Full Scale Production quantities.

• Be a link between R&D, production and qualification department, with thorough understanding how design choices impact assembly line.

• Perform material flow and value chain analysis

• Design assembly lines which comply to safety and quality requirements to assure repeatable processes and quality of the final product.

• Assemble prototypes and assure the product maturity necessary to pass review gates

• Write, maintain, and follow SOPs for assembly, integration, and testing operations, ensuring safety and repeatability at every step.

• Support troubleshooting and corrective actions in collaboration with engineering and QA teams.

• Contribute to continuous improvement of assembly workflows while maintaining compliance with safety and quality requirements.

Requirements

What You'll Need

• Several years of industrialization experience with maintaining full R&D to Production workflow

• Excellent hands-on engineering

• Experience with various manufacturing methods; milling, turning, plastic injection moulding, casting, 3D printing.

• Experience or willingness to work with energetic, pyrotechnic, or otherwise hazardous materials; knowledge of relevant safety requirements is a strong advantage.

• Experience with quality control, functional testing, and documentation standards in a production or engineering environment.

• Ability to write and execute SOPs in a detail-driven, safety-critical environment.

• High attention to detail and a disciplined, methodical approach to assembly and testing.

• Willingness to travel when setting up a suppliers and manufacturers

• Fluency in English and German required; any other language is a plus.

Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach.

We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting.

Why this is interesting

  • Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments.

  • An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users.

  • Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities

  • Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan.

  • Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation.

What You'll Do

  • Bring global flood models to the local scale

  • Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datasets and adapt them to the catchments our customers care about.

  • Use our own sensor data alongside public gauge, reanalysis and radar data to fine-tune and validate those models locally.

  • Tackle prediction in ungauged and data-scarce basins through transfer learning and regionalisation.

  • Own hydrological modelling end to end: set the technical direction, decide when to adapt pre-trained models or train our own, and lead the work from experimentation through validation to production.

  • Work as one modelling team

  • Make practical trade-offs between forecast accuracy, model complexity and development effort to build a reliable product that meets customer needs.

  • Work side by side with our hydrologist specialising in rainfall radar and nowcasting to directly integrate rainfall nowcasts into your flood models.

  • Work with software engineers to put models into production and monitor their performance.

  • Identify and test advances in ML flood forecasting, turning promising research into more accurate and reliable forecasts for our customers.

  • Stay close to the real world

  • We believe the best modellers understand the world behind their models. We encourage you to join field deployments and customer conversations to build that understanding firsthand.

  • You are an opinionated contributor to key technical decisions.

Who You Are

  • You’ve built and validated hydrological ML models across many catchments and have experience taking modelling work into real-world use.

  • You combine scientific rigour with product judgement: you test assumptions, understand uncertainty and focus on improvements that matter to customers.

  • You take ownership from an open question to a working solution. You set priorities, make decisions and keep moving without waiting for perfect information.

  • You care deeply about the quality of your work. You dig into why models fail, follow problems through and stay invested in how your forecasts perform after deployment.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in person, can explain your reasoning and trade-offs, and work closely with people across hydrology, software, hardware and field operations.

Technical Requirements

  • Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning ML streamflow or flood models across many catchments at once (regional, continental or global), for example on CAMELS or Caravan. Experience with single-catchment models alone is not sufficient.

  • Experience transferring such models to new or data-scarce catchments through fine-tuning, regionalisation, or prediction in ungauged basins.

  • Strong understanding of rainfall-runoff processes and the limitations of hydrological observations and input data.

  • Experience validating models across unseen catchments and time periods, including assessing flood-peak magnitude, timing and predictive uncertainty.

  • Strong Python skills, with experience writing maintainable code for data processing, modelling and reproducible experiments.

  • Practical depth in deep learning for time series, including developing, training and debugging models in PyTorch or a comparable framework.

  • MSc or PhD in hydrology, water resources, atmospheric sciences, machine learning, or equivalent.

Nice to Have

  • Publications or open-source work on large-sample hydrology, transfer learning, or ungauged-basin prediction.

  • Experience with NeuralHydrology, ERA5 or similar global forcing datasets.

  • Experience with sub-daily or event-based flood modelling.

  • Experience processing large hydrometeorological datasets with tools such as xarray and Dask, and formats such as Zarr.

  • Previous early startup experience.

Role Details

  • Contract: Permanent, full-time (100% FTE).

  • Start date: immediately

  • Reports to: CTO.

  • Compensation: Commensurate with experience + equity

  • Growth: a key early hire with the opportunity to shape Riverkin's flood modelling as the team grows.

  • Location: Four days per week in our Zurich office and one day working from home.

  • Work authorisation: Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit, is required.

  • Working language: English. German is not required.

We are a well-capitalized Swiss startup building real-time sensing and data infrastructure for rivers. raw.description:

Als IT Reliability Engineer bist du Teil unseres Engineering-Teams und übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Stabilität, Überwachung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung bestehender Kundenumgebungen.

Du sorgst dafür, dass Systeme zuverlässig betrieben werden, technische Risiken frühzeitig erkannt werden und Monitoring-, Backup-, Update- sowie Lifecycle-Prozesse nachhaltig funktionieren. Dabei leistest du einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Servicequalität und zur langfristigen Stabilität unserer Kundenumgebungen.

Die Themen Monitoring, Betriebsstabilität, Lifecycle-Management und technische Qualitätsstandards haben bei MDigital bereits heute einen hohen Stellenwert und werden aktiv durch unser Engineering-Team gelebt. Aufgrund des Unternehmenswachstums und der zunehmenden Bedeutung dieser Aufgaben investieren wir nun gezielt in eine spezialisierte Rolle innerhalb des Engineering-Teams.

Da diese Position neu geschaffen wird, hast du die Möglichkeit, die zukünftige Ausgestaltung der Rolle aktiv mitzuprägen. Mit dem weiteren Wachstum des Unternehmens besteht zudem die Perspektive, den Bereich IT Reliability Engineering langfristig weiter auszubauen und zusätzliche Mitarbeitende in diesem Umfeld zu etablieren.

Aufgaben

Monitoring & Infrastruktur

  • Überwachung sämtlicher Kundensysteme über unsere Monitoring-Plattformen

  • Überwachung von Verfügbarkeit, Diensten, Hardware- und Storage-Zuständen
  • Frühzeitige Erkennung technischer und sicherheitsrelevanter Risiken

  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Monitoring-Prozesse
  • Identifikation und Umsetzung von Verbesserungen zur Erhöhung der Betriebsstabilität

  • Analyse wiederkehrender Incidents und Erarbeitung nachhaltiger Lösungen

Backup & Recovery

  • Sicherstellung funktionierender Backup- und Recovery-Prozesse
  • Nachverfolgung fehlerhafter Sicherungen
  • Integration neuer Systeme in bestehende Backup-Konzepte
  • Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation regelmässiger Restore-Tests

Client-, Server- & Update-Management

  • Überwachung des Update- und Sicherheitsstatus von Clients und Servern
  • Sicherstellung aktueller Sicherheits- und Systemstände
  • Standardisierung und Automatisierung von Update-Prozessen
